refs.text_gb: 雅各举目观看，见以扫来了，同他一起的有四百人。他就把孩子们分开交给利亚、拉结、和两个使女，
refs.text_big5: 雅各舉目觀看，見以掃來了，同他一起的有四百人。他就把孩子們分開交給利亞、拉結、和兩個使女，
refs.text_en: And Jacob lifted up his eyes and looked, and there was Esau coming, and four hundred men with him. So he divided the children among Leah and among Rachel and among the two female servants.

verses.text_gb: 雅各就甚惧怕，而且愁烦，便把那与他同在的人口和羊群、牛群、骆驼分作[Cra]两[Fn1]队，
verses.text_big5: 雅各就甚懼怕，而且愁煩，便把那與他同在的人口和羊群、牛群、駱駝分作[Cra]兩[Fn1]隊，
verses.text_en: Then Jacob was greatly afraid and distressed; and he divided the people who were with him and the flocks and the herds and the camels into two camps;

refs.text_gb: 雅各看见他们就说，这是神的军营，于是给那地方起名叫玛哈念。
refs.text_big5: 雅各看見他們就說，這是神的軍營，於是給那地方起名叫瑪哈念。
refs.text_en: And Jacob said when he saw them, This is God's camp. So he called the name of that place Mahanaim.

verses.text_gb: 说，以扫若来击杀这一队，剩下的那一队还可以逃避。
verses.text_big5: 說，以掃若來擊殺這一隊，剩下的那一隊還可以逃避。
verses.text_en: And he said, If Esau comes to the one camp and attacks it, then the camp which is left will escape.

verses.text_big5_plain: 說，以掃若來擊殺這一隊，剩下的那一隊還可以逃避。

verses.text_gb: 雅各说，耶和华[Cra]我祖亚伯拉罕的神，我父亲以撒的神啊，你曾对我说，[Crb]回你本地，到你亲族那里去，我要善待你。
verses.text_big5: 雅各說，耶和華[Cra]我祖亞伯拉罕的神，我父親以撒的神阿，你曾對我說，[Crb]回你本地，到你親族那裏去，我要善待你。
verses.text_en: Then Jacob said, O God of my father Abraham and God of my father Isaac, O Jehovah, who said to me, Return to your country and to your relatives, and I will do you good,
verses.text_gb_plain: 雅各说，耶和华我祖亚伯拉罕的神，我父亲以撒的神啊，你曾对我说，回你本地，到你亲族那里去，我要善待你。
verses.text_big5_plain: 雅各說，耶和華我祖亞伯拉罕的神，我父親以撒的神阿，你曾對我說，回你本地，到你親族那裏去，我要善待你。

refs.text_gb: 耶和华站在梯子以上，说，我是耶和华你祖亚伯拉罕的神，也是以撒的神；我要将你现在所躺卧之地，赐给你和你的后裔。
refs.text_big5: 耶和華站在梯子以上，說，我是耶和華你祖亞伯拉罕的神，也是以撒的神；我要將你現在所躺臥之地，賜給你和你的後裔。
refs.text_en: And there was Jehovah, standing above it; and He said, I am Jehovah, the God of Abraham your father and the God of Isaac. The land on which you lie, I will give to you and to your seed.

refs.text_gb: 若不是我父亲的神，就是亚伯拉罕的神，以撒所敬畏的神与我同在，你如今必定打发我空手而去。神看见我的苦情和我的劳碌，就在昨夜责备你。
refs.text_big5: 若不是我父親的神，就是亞伯拉罕的神，以撒所敬畏的神與我同在，你如今必定打發我空手而去。神看見我的苦情和我的勞碌，就在昨夜責備你。
refs.text_en: If the God of my father, the God of Abraham, and the Dread of Isaac, had not been with me, surely now you would have sent me away empty. God has seen my affliction and the labor of my hands and rebuked you last night.

refs.text_gb: 但愿亚伯拉罕的神和拿鹤的神，就是他们父亲的神，在你我中间判断。雅各就指着他父亲以撒所敬畏的神起誓，
refs.text_big5: 但願亞伯拉罕的神和拿鶴的神，就是他們父親的神，在你我中間判斷。雅各就指著他父親以撒所敬畏的神起誓，
refs.text_en: The God of Abraham and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, judge between us. And Jacob swore by the Dread of his father Isaac.

refs.text_gb: 耶和华对雅各说，你要回你祖你父之地，到你亲族那里去，我必与你同在。
refs.text_big5: 耶和華對雅各說，你要回你祖你父之地，到你親族那裏去，我必與你同在。
refs.text_en: And Jehovah said to Jacob, Return to the land of your fathers and to your relatives, and I will be with you.

refs.text_gb: 我是伯特利的神；你在那里用油抹过柱子，向我许过愿。现在你起来，离开这地，回你的出生地去吧。
refs.text_big5: 我是伯特利的神；你在那裏用油抹過柱子，向我許過願。現在你起來，離開這地，回你的出生地去罷。
refs.text_en: I am the God of Bethel, where you anointed a pillar, where you vowed a vow to Me. Rise up now; go out from this land, and return to the land of your birth.

verses.text_gb: 你向仆人所施的一切慈爱和信实，我一点也不配得；我先前只拿着我的杖过这约但河，如今我却成了[Cra]两队。
verses.text_big5: 你向僕人所施的一切慈愛和信實，我一點也不配得；我先前只拿著我的杖過這約但河，如今我卻成了[Cra]兩隊。
verses.text_en: I am not worthy of all the lovingkindnesses and all the faithfulness which You have shown to Your servant; for with my staff only I crossed over this Jordan, and now I have become two camps.
verses.text_gb_plain: 你向仆人所施的一切慈爱和信实，我一点也不配得；我先前只拿着我的杖过这约但河，如今我却成了两队。
verses.text_big5_plain: 你向僕人所施的一切慈愛和信實，我一點也不配得；我先前只拿著我的杖過這約但河，如今我卻成了兩隊。

verses.text_gb: 求你救我脱离我哥哥以扫的手；因为我怕他来击杀我，连[Fn1]妻子带儿女一同击杀了。
verses.text_big5: 求你救我脫離我哥哥以掃的手；因為我怕他來擊殺我，連[Fn1]妻子帶兒女一同擊殺了。
verses.text_en: Deliver me, please, from the hand of my brother, from the hand of Esau, for I fear him, lest he come and attack me and the mother with the children.
verses.text_gb_plain: 求你救我脱离我哥哥以扫的手；因为我怕他来击杀我，连妻子带儿女一同击杀了。
verses.text_big5_plain: 求你救我脫離我哥哥以掃的手；因為我怕他來擊殺我，連妻子帶兒女一同擊殺了。

verses.text_gb: 你曾说，我必定善待你，使你的后裔如同[Cra]海沙，多得不可胜数。
verses.text_big5: 你曾說，我必定善待你，使你的後裔如同[Cra]海沙，多得不可勝數。
verses.text_en: But You have said, I will surely do you good and make your seed like the sand of the sea, which cannot be numbered for multitude.
verses.text_gb_plain: 你曾说，我必定善待你，使你的后裔如同海沙，多得不可胜数。
verses.text_big5_plain: 你曾說，我必定善待你，使你的後裔如同海沙，多得不可勝數。

refs.text_gb: 论福，我必赐福给你；论繁增，我必使你的后裔繁增，如同天上的星，海边的沙；你的后裔必得着仇敌的城门；
refs.text_big5: 論福，我必賜福給你；論繁增，我必使你的後裔繁增，如同天上的星，海邊的沙；你的後裔必得著仇敵的城門；
refs.text_en: I will surely bless you and will greatly multiply your seed like the stars of the heavens and like the sand which is on the seashore; and your seed shall possess the gate of his enemies.

refs.text_gb: 你的后裔必像地上的尘沙那样多，必向东西南北开展；地上万族必因你和你的后裔得福。
refs.text_big5: 你的後裔必像地上的塵沙那樣多，必向東西南北開展；地上萬族必因你和你的後裔得福。
refs.text_en: And your seed will be as the dust of the earth, and you will spread abroad to the west and to the east and to the north and to the south, and in you and in your seed will all the families of the earth be blessed.

refs.text_gb: 所以从一个仿佛已死的人，生出子孙来，如同天上的星那样众多，海边的沙那样无数。
refs.text_big5: 所以從一個彷彿已死的人，生出子孫來，如同天上的星那樣眾多，海邊的沙那樣無數。
refs.text_en: Therefore also there were born of one, and that of him who had become dead, as many as even the stars of heaven in multitude and as the sand by the seashore innumerable.

verses.text_big5: 當夜，雅各在那裏住宿，就從他所有的物中拿[Fn1][Cra]禮物，要送給他哥哥以掃：
verses.text_en: And he spent that night there. Then from what he had with him he took a present for Esau his brother:

refs.text_gb: 他们的父亲以色列对他们说，若必须如此，你们就当这样行：可以取些这地佳美的出产，就是一点香油和一点蜂蜜，香胶和没药，榧子和杏仁，收在器皿里，带下去送给那人作礼物；
refs.text_big5: 他們的父親以色列對他們說，若必須如此，你們就當這樣行：可以取些這地佳美的出產，就是一點香油和一點蜂蜜，香膠和沒藥，榧子和杏仁，收在器皿裏，帶下去送給那人作禮物；
refs.text_en: And their father Israel said to them, If it must be so, then do this: Take some of the choice fruits of the land in your bags, and carry a present down to the man-a little balm and a little honey, aromatic gum and myrrh, pistachio nuts and almonds.

refs.text_gb: 人的礼物为他开路，引他到尊大的人面前。
refs.text_big5: 人的禮物為他開路，引他到尊大的人面前。
refs.text_en: A man's gift makes room for him / And brings him before great men.

refs.text_gb: 慷慨的，有多人求他的恩情；爱送礼的，人都为他的朋友。
refs.text_big5: 慷慨的，有多人求他的恩情；愛送禮的，人都為他的朋友。
refs.text_en: Many will entreat the favor of the generous man, / And every man is a friend to one who gives gifts.

refs.text_gb: 暗中送的礼物平息怒气，怀中搋的礼品止息暴怒。
refs.text_big5: 暗中送的禮物平息怒氣，懷中搋的禮品止息暴怒。
refs.text_en: A gift in secret pacifies anger; / And a present in the bosom, strong wrath.

verses.text_gb: 又吩咐尽先走的说，我哥哥以扫遇见你的时候，问你说，你是哪家的人？要往哪里去？你前头这些牲畜是谁的？
verses.text_big5: 又吩咐儘先走的說，我哥哥以掃遇見你的時候，問你說，你是那家的人？要往那裏去？你前頭這些牲畜是誰的？
verses.text_en: And he commanded the foremost, saying, When Esau my brother meets you and asks you, saying, To whom do you belong? And where are you going? And whose animals are these before you?
verses.text_gb_plain: 又吩咐尽先走的说，我哥哥以扫遇见你的时候，问你说，你是哪家的人？要往哪里去？你前头这些牲畜是谁的？

verses.text_gb: 你就说，是你仆人雅各的，是送给我主以扫的礼物；他自己也在我们后边。
verses.text_big5: 你就說，是你僕人雅各的，是送給我主以掃的禮物；他自己也在我們後邊。
verses.text_en: Then you will say, Your servant Jacob's; it is a present sent to my lord Esau; and now he also is behind us.

verses.text_big5: 又吩咐第二、第三、和一切趕群畜的人說，你們遇見以掃的時候，也要這樣對他說；

verses.text_en: And you shall also say, Your servant Jacob is right behind us. For he said, I will appease him with the present that goes before me, and afterward I will see his face; perhaps he will accept me.

verses.text_en: And he rose up that night and took his two wives and his two female servants and his eleven children and crossed over the ford of the Jabbok.

verses.text_en: And he took them and sent them over the stream and sent over what he had.

footnotes.zh: 按照何十二4，这人乃是耶和华的使者基督(见出三2注1)。主作为一个人与雅各摔跤，好摸着雅各天然的力量(由雅各大腿窝的筋所表征—25，32。)主与雅各摔跤持续了相当长的时间，这充分暴露出雅各是何等天然。
footnotes.zh_big5: 按照何十二4，這人乃是耶和華的使者基督。（見出三2註1。）主作為一個人與雅各摔跤，好摸著雅各天然的力量（由雅各大腿窩的筋所表徵—25，32。）主與雅各摔跤持續了相當長的時間，這充分暴露出雅各是何等天然。
footnotes.en: 32:24 1 man According to Hosea 12:4, this man was the Angel of Jehovah, Christ (see note Exo. 3:2 1 ). The Lord as a man wrestled with Jacob so that He might touch Jacob's natural strength, signified by the socket of Jacob's hip at the thigh muscle (vv. 25, 32). The Lord's wrestling with Jacob lasted a considerable time, fully exposing how natural Jacob was.

refs.text_en: In the womb he grasped his brother by the heel, / And in his full strength he contended with God.

refs.text_en: Indeed he contended with the Angel and prevailed; / He wept and made supplication to Him. / At Bethel he found Him; / And there He spoke with us,

verses.text_gb: [Fn1]那人见自己胜不过他，就将他的大腿窝[Fn2]摸了一把；雅各正与那人摔跤的时候，他的大腿窝就脱了节。
verses.text_big5: [Fn1]那人見自己勝不過他，就將他的大腿窩[Fn2]摸了一把；雅各正與那人摔跤的時候，他的大腿窩就脫了節。
verses.text_en: And when the man saw that He did not prevail against him, He touched the socket of his hip; and the socket of Jacob's hip was dislocated as he wrestled with Him.
verses.text_gb_plain: 那人见自己胜不过他，就将他的大腿窝摸了一把；雅各正与那人摔跤的时候，他的大腿窝就脱了节。
verses.text_big5_plain: 那人見自己勝不過他，就將他的大腿窩摸了一把；雅各正與那人摔跤的時候，他的大腿窩就脫了節。

footnotes.en: 32:25 1 the man Lit., He.

footnotes.zh: 雅各大腿窝的筋，就是身上最有力的肌肉，被摸了一把(32)，这表征雅各天然的生命，天然的力量，被摸了一把。这是雅各变化的开始。三三章给我们看见(见该章4注1与17注1)，在这次的经历之后，雅各依旧天然。然而，尽管雅各外面的生活并无改变，但他天然的生命，他里面天然的力量，已经被主对付了。这是由雅各的大腿瘸了的事实所表征(31)。宗教的路是改变人外面的行为；神在祂经纶里的路，却是摸人里面的生命，好改变人内在的所是。
footnotes.zh_big5: 雅各大腿窩的筋，就是身上最有力的肌肉，被摸了一把，（32，）這表徵雅各天然的生命，天然的力量，被摸了一把。這是雅各變化的開始。三三章給我們看見，（見三三4註1與17註1，）在這次的經歷之後，雅各依舊天然。然而，儘管雅各外面的生活並無改變，但他天然的生命，他裏面天然的力量，已經被主對付了。這是由雅各的大腿瘸了的事實所表徵。（31。）宗教的路是改變人外面的行為；神在祂經綸裏的路，卻是摸人裏面的生命，好改變人內在的所是。
footnotes.en: 32:25 2 touched The touching of the socket of Jacob's hip at the thigh muscle (v. 32), the strongest muscle in the body, signifies the touching of Jacob's natural life, his natural strength. This was the beginning of Jacob's transformation. As Gen. 33 shows (see note Gen. 33:4 1 and note Gen. 33:17 1 ), after this experience Jacob was still natural. Nevertheless, although there was no change in Jacob's outward living, his natural life, his inward natural strength, had been dealt with by the Lord. This is signified by the fact that Jacob walked with a limp (v. 31). The way of religion is to change man's outward behavior; the way of God in His economy is to touch man's inward life in order to change his inward being.

refs.text_big5: 耶穌又對他們講一個比喻，是要人常常禱告，不可灰心，說，

verses.text_gb: 那人对他说，[Fn1]你名叫什么？他说，我名叫雅各。
verses.text_big5: 那人對他說，[Fn1]你名叫甚麼？他說，我名叫雅各。
verses.text_en: And He said to him, What is your name? And he said, Jacob.
verses.text_gb_plain: 那人对他说，你名叫什么？他说，我名叫雅各。
verses.text_big5_plain: 那人對他說，你名叫甚麼？他說，我名叫雅各。

footnotes.zh: 这里主问雅各的名字，是要叫他知道自己是谁；他乃是雅各，一个抓夺者(见二五26注2)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這裏主問雅各的名字，是要叫他知道自己是誰；他乃是雅各，一個抓奪者。（見二五26註2。）
footnotes.en: 32:27 1 What Here the Lord asked Jacob his name to cause Jacob to realize who he was — Jacob, the supplanter (see note Gen. 25:26 2 ).

verses.text_gb: 那人说，你的名不要再叫雅各，要叫[Fn1][Cra]以色列；因为你与神与人[Crb]较力，都得了胜。
verses.text_big5: 那人說，你的名不要再叫雅各，要叫[Fn1][Cra]以色列；因為你與神與人[Crb]較力，都得了勝。
verses.text_en: And He said, Your name will no longer be called Jacob, but Israel; for you have struggled with God and with men, and have prevailed.
verses.text_gb_plain: 那人说，你的名不要再叫雅各，要叫以色列；因为你与神与人较力，都得了胜。
verses.text_big5_plain: 那人說，你的名不要再叫雅各，要叫以色列；因為你與神與人較力，都得了勝。

footnotes.zh: 意，与神较力者。雅各的名字改为以色列，指明神至终要变化雅各。见十七5注2。
footnotes.zh_big5: 意，與神較力者。雅各的名字改為以色列，指明神至終要變化雅各。見十七5註2。
footnotes.en: 32:28 1 Israel Meaning one who struggles with God. The changing of Jacob's name to Israel indicates that God would eventually transform Jacob. See note Gen. 17:5 2 .

refs.text_gb: 并且对他说，你的名原是雅各，从今以后不要再叫雅各，要叫以色列。这样，神就给他起名叫以色列。
refs.text_big5: 並且對他說，你的名原是雅各，從今以後不要再叫雅各，要叫以色列。這樣，神就給他起名叫以色列。
refs.text_en: And God said to him, Your name is Jacob; / Your name shall no longer be called Jacob, / But Israel shall be your name. Thus He called his name Israel.

refs.text_gb: 他们直到今日仍照先前的风俗去行，不专心敬畏耶和华，不照着雅各子孙的律例和典章，也不照着耶和华吩咐他们的律法和诫命而行；这雅各，就是从前耶和华起名叫以色列的。
refs.text_big5: 他們直到今日仍照先前的風俗去行，不專心敬畏耶和華，不照著雅各子孫的律例和典章，也不照著耶和華吩咐他們的律法和誡命而行；這雅各，就是從前耶和華起名叫以色列的。
refs.text_en: Unto this day they have done according to their former customs: They do not fear Jehovah; nor do they act according to their statutes and their ordinances, nor according to the law and commandment that Jehovah commanded the sons of Jacob, whom He named Israel.

verses.text_gb: 雅各问祂说，请将你的名[Cra]告诉我。但那人说，你何必问我的名？于是祂在那里给雅各祝[Fn1]福。

verses.text_en: And Jacob asked Him and said, Please tell me Your name. But He said, Why is it that you ask My name? And He blessed him there.
verses.text_gb_plain: 雅各问祂说，请将你的名告诉我。但那人说，你何必问我的名？于是祂在那里给雅各祝福。
verses.text_big5_plain: 雅各問祂說，請將你的名告訴我。但那人說，你何必問我的名？於是祂在那裏給雅各祝福。

footnotes.zh: 这里没有说那人与雅各摔跤之前到他这里来(24)，也没有说那人与雅各摔跤之后离开了他。这意思是说，与雅各摔跤的主一直与他同在，从未离开他。参约二十26与注3。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這裏沒有說那人與雅各摔跤之前到他這裏來，（24，）也沒有說那人與雅各摔跤之後離開了他。這意思是說，與雅各摔跤的主一直與他同在，從未離開他。參約二十26與註3。
footnotes.en: 32:29 1 It does not say that the man came to Jacob before wrestling with him (v. 24), nor does it say that the man left Jacob after wrestling with him. This means that the Lord who wrestled with Jacob was with him all the time and never left him. Cf. John 20:26 and note John 20:26 3 .

refs.text_big5: 耶和華的使者對他說，你何必問我的名，我的名是奇妙的。
refs.text_en: And the Angel of Jehovah said to him, Why do you ask about My name, since it is wonderful?

verses.text_gb: 雅各便给那地方起名叫[Fn1]毗努伊勒，因为他说，我面对面[Cra]看见了神，我的性命仍得保全。

verses.text_en: And Jacob called the name of the place Peniel, for, he said, I have seen God face to face, and yet my life has been preserved.

refs.text_gb: 说，看哪，耶和华我们神将祂的荣光和祂的伟大显给我们看，我们又听见祂的声音从火中出来；今日我们得见神与人说话，人还存活。
refs.text_big5: 說，看哪，耶和華我們神將祂的榮光和祂的偉大顯給我們看，我們又聽見祂的聲音從火中出來；今日我們得見神與人說話，人還存活。
refs.text_en: And said, Jehovah our God has just shown us His glory and His greatness, and His voice we have heard from the midst of the fire; today we have seen that God speaks with man and yet he lives.

refs.text_gb: 基甸见祂是耶和华的使者，就说，哀哉！主耶和华啊，我不好了，因为我面对面看见了耶和华的使者。
refs.text_big5: 基甸見祂是耶和華的使者，就說，哀哉！主耶和華阿，我不好了，因為我面對面看見了耶和華的使者。
refs.text_en: And Gideon saw that He was the Angel of Jehovah. And Gideon said, Alas, O Lord Jehovah! For I have seen the Angel of Jehovah face to face.

refs.text_gb: 玛挪亚对他的妻子说，我们必要死，因为看见了神。
refs.text_big5: 瑪挪亞對他的妻子說，我們必要死，因為看見了神。
refs.text_en: And Manoah said to his wife, We will surely die, for we have seen God.

refs.text_gb: 又说，你不能看见我的面，因为没有人看见我的面还能存活。
refs.text_big5: 又說，你不能看見我的面，因為沒有人看見我的面還能存活。
refs.text_en: But He said, You cannot see My face, for no man shall see Me and live.

refs.text_gb: 那时我说，祸哉，我灭亡了！因为我是嘴唇不洁的人，又住在嘴唇不洁的民中；又因我眼见大君王万军之耶和华。
refs.text_big5: 那時我說，禍哉，我滅亡了！因為我是嘴脣不潔的人，又住在嘴脣不潔的民中；又因我眼見大君王萬軍之耶和華。
refs.text_en: Then I said, Woe is me, for I am finished! / For I am a man of unclean lips, / And in the midst of a people of unclean lips I dwell; / Yet my eyes have seen the King, Jehovah of hosts.

verses.text_en: And Esau ran to meet him and embraced him and fell on his neck and kissed him, and they wept.
verses.text_gb_plain: 以扫跑来迎接他，将他抱住，又伏在他的颈项上，与他亲嘴，两个人就哭了。
verses.text_big5_plain: 以掃跑來迎接他，將他抱住，又伏在他的頸項上，與他親嘴，兩個人就哭了。

footnotes.zh: 雅各所有的恐惧都是他自己忧虑的产物，而他运用天然技巧和能力拯救自己所作的一切，都是徒然的。神借着在梦中向拉班显现(三一24)，保护了雅各脱离拉班的手；祂又激发以扫向着雅各的兄弟之爱。这些是神顾念祂拣选之人的奇妙作为。因此，雅各既有神的应许，又在达到神目标的路途上，他就无须惧怕在他后面或在他前面的是什么。他不该信靠自己的挣扎努力，乃该安息于神并祂全丰全足的看顾(参腓四6～7，彼前五7)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 雅各所有的恐懼都是他自己憂慮的產物，而他運用天然技巧和能力拯救自己所作的一切，都是徒然的。神藉著在夢中向拉班顯現，（三一24，）保護了雅各脫離拉班的手；祂又激發以掃向著雅各的兄弟之愛。這些是神顧念祂揀選之人的奇妙作為。因此，雅各既有神的應許，又在達到神目標的路途上，他就無須懼怕在他後面或在他前面的是甚麼。他不該信靠自己的掙扎努力，乃該安息於神並祂全豐全足的看顧。（參腓四6～7，彼前五7。）
footnotes.en: 33:4 1 kissed All Jacob's fears were products of his own worrying, and all he had done in exercising his natural skill and ability to save himself was in vain. God had protected Jacob from Laban by appearing to Laban in a dream (Gen. 31:24), and He had aroused Esau's brotherly love toward Jacob. These were God's marvelous acts to care for His chosen one. Thus, Jacob, who had God's promises and was on the way to reach God's goal, did not need to fear what was behind him or what was ahead of him. Instead of trusting in his own striving, he should have rested in God and in His all-sufficient care (cf. Phil. 4:6-7; 1 Pet. 5:7).

verses.text_gb: 以扫举目看见妇人孩子，就说，这些和你同行的是谁？雅各说，这些孩子是神[Cra]施恩给你仆人的。
verses.text_big5: 以掃舉目看見婦人孩子，就說，這些和你同行的是誰？雅各說，這些孩子是神[Cra]施恩給你僕人的。
verses.text_en: And he lifted up his eyes and saw the women and the children and said, Who are these with you? And he said, The children whom God has graciously given your servant.

refs.text_gb: 约瑟对他父亲说，他们是神在这里赐给我的儿子。以色列说，请你领他们到我跟前，我要给他们祝福。
refs.text_big5: 約瑟對他父親說，他們是神在這裏賜給我的兒子。以色列說，請你領他們到我跟前，我要給他們祝福。
refs.text_en: And Joseph said to his father, They are my sons, whom God has given to me, please, here. And he said, Bring them to me, that I may bless them.

refs.text_gb: 看哪，儿女是耶和华所赐的产业；腹中的果子是祂所给的赏赐。
refs.text_big5: 看哪，兒女是耶和華所賜的產業；腹中的果子是祂所給的賞賜。
refs.text_en: Behold, children are the heritage of Jehovah, / The fruit of the womb a reward.

refs.text_gb: 看哪，我与耶和华所给我的儿女，就是从住在锡安山万军之耶和华来的，在以色列中作为兆头和奇事。
refs.text_big5: 看哪，我與耶和華所給我的兒女，就是從住在錫安山萬軍之耶和華來的，在以色列中作為兆頭和奇事。
refs.text_en: See, I and the children whom Jehovah has given me are for signs and wonders in Israel from Jehovah of hosts, who abides on Mount Zion.

verses.text_gb: 于是两个使女和她们的孩子前来下拜；
verses.text_big5: 於是兩個使女和她們的孩子前來下拜；
verses.text_en: Then the female servants came near, they and their children, and they bowed down.
verses.text_gb_plain: 于是两个使女和她们的孩子前来下拜；
verses.text_big5_plain: 於是兩個使女和她們的孩子前來下拜；

verses.text_big5: 利亞和她的孩子也前來下拜；隨後約瑟和拉結也前來下拜。
verses.text_en: And Leah also came near with her children, and they bowed down; and afterward Joseph came near with Rachel, and they bowed down.
verses.text_gb_plain: 利亚和她的孩子也前来下拜；随后约瑟和拉结也前来下拜。
verses.text_big5_plain: 利亞和她的孩子也前來下拜；隨後約瑟和拉結也前來下拜。

verses.text_gb: 以扫说，我所遇见的这一整[Fn1][Cra]队是什么意思？雅各说，是要在我主眼前蒙[Crb]恩的。
verses.text_big5: 以掃說，我所遇見的這一整[Fn1][Cra]隊是甚麼意思？雅各說，是要在我主眼前蒙[Crb]恩的。
verses.text_en: And Esau said, What do you mean by all this camp which I met? And he said, To find favor in the sight of my lord.
verses.text_gb_plain: 以扫说，我所遇见的这一整队是什么意思？雅各说，是要在我主眼前蒙恩的。
verses.text_big5_plain: 以掃說，我所遇見的這一整隊是甚麼意思？雅各說，是要在我主眼前蒙恩的。

footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，營。

refs.text_en: And he delivered them into the hand of his servants, every drove by itself, and said to his servants, Cross over before me, and put a space between each drove.

refs.text_gb: 我有牛、驴、羊群、仆人、婢女，现在打发人来报告我主，为要在你眼前蒙恩。
refs.text_big5: 我有牛、驢、羊群、僕人、婢女，現在打發人來報告我主，為要在你眼前蒙恩。
refs.text_en: And I have oxen and donkeys and flocks, and male servants and female servants; and I have sent to tell my lord this, that I may find favor in your sight.

refs.text_gb: 以扫说，让我把跟随我的人留几个在你这里。雅各说，何必呢？只要在我主眼前蒙恩就是了。
refs.text_big5: 以掃說，讓我把跟隨我的人留幾個在你這裏。雅各說，何必呢？只要在我主眼前蒙恩就是了。
refs.text_en: So Esau said, Let me please leave with you some of the people who are with me. And he said, What need is there? Let me find favor in the sight of my lord.

verses.text_gb: 以扫说，弟弟啊，我的已经够了，你的仍归你吧。
verses.text_big5: 以掃說，弟弟阿，我的已經彀了，你的仍歸你罷。
verses.text_en: And Esau said, I have enough, my brother; let what you have be yours.
verses.text_gb_plain: 以扫说，弟弟啊，我的已经够了，你的仍归你吧。
verses.text_big5_plain: 以掃說，弟弟阿，我的已經彀了，你的仍歸你罷。

verses.text_gb: 雅各说，不然，我若在你眼前蒙恩，就求你从我手里收下这礼物；因为我看见你的面，如同看见神的面，并且你悦纳了我。
verses.text_big5: 雅各說，不然，我若在你眼前蒙恩，就求你從我手裏收下這禮物；因為我看見你的面，如同看見神的面，並且你悅納了我。
verses.text_en: And Jacob said, No, please, if now I have found favor in your sight, then take my present from my hand; for I see your face as one sees the face of God, and you have received me favorably.
verses.text_gb_plain: 雅各说，不然，我若在你眼前蒙恩，就求你从我手里收下这礼物；因为我看见你的面，如同看见神的面，并且你悦纳了我。

verses.text_gb: 求你收下我带来给你的[Fn1][Cra]礼物；因为神恩待了我，并且我一切都有了。雅各再三地求他，他才收下了。

verses.text_en: Please take my blessing which has been brought to you, because God has dealt graciously with me, and because I have all that I need. So he urged him, and he took it.
verses.text_gb_plain: 求你收下我带来给你的礼物；因为神恩待了我，并且我一切都有了。雅各再三地求他，他才收下了。

footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，祝福。

refs.text_big5: 如今求你將婢女給我主送來的這禮物，給跟隨我主的少年人。
refs.text_en: And now this present which your servant has brought to my lord, let it be given to the young men who follow my lord.

refs.text_gb: 乃缦带着一切跟随他的人，回到神人那里；他进去，站在他面前，说，如今我知道，除了在以色列之外，全地并没有神。现在求你收下仆人的礼物。
refs.text_big5: 乃縵帶著一切跟隨他的人，回到神人那裏；他進去，站在他面前，說，如今我知道，除了在以色列之外，全地並沒有神。現在求你收下僕人的禮物。
refs.text_en: And he returned to the man of God, he and all his company, and came and stood before him and said, Now I know that there is no God in all the earth except with Israel. And now, please accept a present from your servant.

verses.text_gb: 以扫说，我们可以起身前去，我要在你前头走。
verses.text_big5: 以掃說，我們可以起身前去，我要在你前頭走。
verses.text_en: Then Esau said, Let us take our journey and go, and I will go before you.
verses.text_gb_plain: 以扫说，我们可以起身前去，我要在你前头走。
verses.text_big5_plain: 以掃說，我們可以起身前去，我要在你前頭走。

verses.text_gb: 雅各对他说，我主知道孩子们年幼娇嫩，正在乳养的牛羊也是我所挂心的，若是催赶一天，[Fn1]牲畜都必死了。

verses.text_en: And he said to him, My lord knows that the children are frail and that the nursing flocks and herds are a concern to me; and if they overdrive them for one day, all the flock will die.
verses.text_gb_plain: 雅各对他说，我主知道孩子们年幼娇嫩，正在乳养的牛羊也是我所挂心的，若是催赶一天，牲畜都必死了。

verses.text_en: Let my lord please pass on before his servant, and I will lead on slowly according to the pace of the cattle which are before me and according to the pace of the children, until I come to my lord at Seir.

refs.text_gb: 示剑对少女的父亲和弟兄们说，但愿我在你们眼前蒙恩，你们向我要什么，我必给你们。
refs.text_big5: 示劍對少女的父親和弟兄們說，但願我在你們眼前蒙恩，你們向我要甚麼，我必給你們。
refs.text_en: And Shechem said to her father and to her brothers, Let me find favor in your sight, and whatever you say to me I will give.

refs.text_en: And they said, You have saved our lives. May we find favor in the sight of my lord and be Pharaoh's servants.

verses.text_en: And Jacob journeyed to Succoth and built a house for himself and made booths for his livestock; therefore the name of the place is called Succoth.

footnotes.zh: 雅各为自己盖造一座房屋，又为牲畜搭棚，指明他仍是天然并且为着自己。他轻忽在伯特利所作的梦，以及向神所许的愿，应许要为神建造家(二八20～22)。

refs.text_en: And they were carried over to Shechem and placed in the tomb which Abraham had bought for a sum of silver from the sons of Hamor in Shechem.

refs.text_gb: 于是到了撒玛利亚的一座城，名叫叙加，靠近雅各给他儿子约瑟的那块地，
refs.text_big5: 於是到了撒瑪利亞的一座城，名叫敘加，靠近雅各給他兒子約瑟的那塊地，
refs.text_en: So He came to a city of Samaria called Sychar, near the piece of land that Jacob gave to Joseph his son;

refs.text_gb: 他因着信，在应许之地作客，好像在异地，与承受同样应许的以撒、雅各一同居住在帐棚里；
refs.text_big5: 他因著信，在應許之地作客，好像在異地，與承受同樣應許的以撒、雅各一同居住在帳棚裏；
refs.text_en: By faith he dwelt as a foreigner in the land of promise as in a foreign land, making his home in tents with Isaac and Jacob, the fellow heirs of the same promise;

verses.text_gb: 在那里筑了一座[Fn1][Cra]坛，起名叫[Fn2]伊勒伊罗伊以色列。
verses.text_big5: 在那裏築了一座[Fn1][Cra]壇，起名叫[Fn2]伊勒伊羅伊以色列。
verses.text_en: And there he erected an altar and called it El-Elohe-Israel.
verses.text_gb_plain: 在那里筑了一座坛，起名叫伊勒伊罗伊以色列。
verses.text_big5_plain: 在那裏築了一座壇，起名叫伊勒伊羅伊以色列。

footnotes.zh: 雅各在迦南地的示剑支搭帐棚(19)，并筑了一座坛，像他祖父亚伯拉罕所作的一样(十二6～7)。在此雅各开始过蒙神呼召者的生活，使神的定旨得以完成。
footnotes.zh_big5: 雅各在迦南地的示劍支搭帳棚，（19，）並築了一座壇，像他祖父亞伯拉罕所作的一樣。（十二6～7。）在此雅各開始過蒙神呼召者的生活，使神的定旨得以完成。
footnotes.en: 33:20 1 altar In Shechem in the land of Canaan, Jacob pitched his tent (v. 19) and erected an altar, as his grandfather Abraham had done (Gen. 12:6-7). Here Jacob began to live a life as God's called one for the fulfillment of God's purpose.

footnotes.zh: 意，神，以色列的神。
footnotes.zh_big5: 意，神，以色列的神。
footnotes.en: 33:20 2 El-Elohe-Israel Meaning El, the God of Israel.

refs.text_gb: 耶和华向亚伯兰显现，说，我要把这地赐给你的后裔。亚伯兰就在那里为向他显现的耶和华筑了一座坛。
refs.text_big5: 耶和華向亞伯蘭顯現，說，我要把這地賜給你的後裔。亞伯蘭就在那裏為向他顯現的耶和華築了一座壇。
refs.text_en: And Jehovah appeared to Abram and said, To your seed I will give this land. And there he built an altar to Jehovah who had appeared to him.

verses.text_gb: 利亚给雅各所生的女儿[Cra]底拿出去，要见那地的女子们。
verses.text_big5: 利亞給雅各所生的女兒[Cra]底拿出去，要見那地的女子們。
verses.text_en: And Dinah the daughter of Leah, whom she had borne to Jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.
verses.text_gb_plain: 利亚给雅各所生的女儿底拿出去，要见那地的女子们。
verses.text_big5_plain: 利亞給雅各所生的女兒底拿出去，要見那地的女子們。

refs.text_gb: 后来又生了一个女儿，给她起名叫底拿。
refs.text_big5: 後來又生了一個女兒，給她起名叫底拿。
refs.text_en: And afterward she bore a daughter and called her name Dinah.

verses.text_gb: 那地的族长希未人哈抹的儿子示剑看见她，就拉住她，与她同寝，玷辱了她。
verses.text_big5: 那地的族長希未人哈抹的兒子示劍看見她，就拉住她，與她同寢，玷辱了她。
verses.text_en: And when Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, the prince of the land, saw her, he took her and lay with her and humbled her.
verses.text_gb_plain: 那地的族长希未人哈抹的儿子示剑看见她，就拉住她，与她同寝，玷辱了她。
verses.text_big5_plain: 那地的族長希未人哈抹的兒子示劍看見她，就拉住她，與她同寢，玷辱了她。

verses.text_gb: 示剑的[Fn1]心系恋雅各的女儿底拿，爱这少女，[Fn2]甜言蜜语地安慰她。
verses.text_big5: 示劍的[Fn1]心繫戀雅各的女兒底拿，愛這少女，[Fn2]甜言蜜語的安慰她。
verses.text_en: And his soul clung to Dinah the daughter of Jacob, and he loved the girl and spoke affectionately to the girl.
verses.text_gb_plain: 示剑的心系恋雅各的女儿底拿，爱这少女，甜言蜜语地安慰她。
verses.text_big5_plain: 示劍的心繫戀雅各的女兒底拿，愛這少女，甜言蜜語的安慰她。

footnotes.zh: 直译，魂。8节者同。
footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，魂。8節者同。
footnotes.en: 34:3 1 affectionately Lit., to the heart of.

footnotes.zh: 直译，对她的心说话。
footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，對她的心說話。

verses.text_gb: 示剑对他父亲哈抹说，求你为我聘这女孩子为[Cra]妻。
verses.text_big5: 示劍對他父親哈抹說，求你為我聘這女孩子為[Cra]妻。
verses.text_en: And Shechem spoke to his father Hamor, saying, Get me this young girl as a wife.
verses.text_gb_plain: 示剑对他父亲哈抹说，求你为我聘这女孩子为妻。
verses.text_big5_plain: 示劍對他父親哈抹說，求你為我聘這女孩子為妻。

refs.text_gb: 参孙上来告诉他父母说，我在亭拿看见一个女子，是非利士人的女儿，愿你们给我娶来为妻。
refs.text_big5: 參孫上來告訴他父母說，我在亭拿看見一個女子，是非利士人的女兒，願你們給我娶來為妻。
refs.text_en: And he went up and told his father and mother and said, I have seen a woman in Timnah from the daughters of the Philistines. Now therefore get her for me as a wife.

verses.text_gb: 雅各听见示剑玷污了他的女儿底拿；那时他的儿子们正和群畜在田野，雅各就不作声，等他们回来。
verses.text_big5: 雅各聽見示劍玷污了他的女兒底拿；那時他的兒子們正和群畜在田野，雅各就不作聲，等他們回來。
verses.text_en: Now when Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah his daughter, his sons were with his livestock in the field; so Jacob kept silent until they came in.
verses.text_gb_plain: 雅各听见示剑玷污了他的女儿底拿；那时他的儿子们正和群畜在田野，雅各就不作声，等他们回来。
verses.text_big5_plain: 雅各聽見示劍玷污了他的女兒底拿；那時他的兒子們正和群畜在田野，雅各就不作聲，等他們回來。

verses.text_gb: 示剑的父亲哈抹出来见雅各，要和他商议。
verses.text_big5: 示劍的父親哈抹出來見雅各，要和他商議。
verses.text_en: And Hamor the father of Shechem went out to Jacob to speak with him.
verses.text_gb_plain: 示剑的父亲哈抹出来见雅各，要和他商议。
verses.text_big5_plain: 示劍的父親哈抹出來見雅各，要和他商議。

verses.text_gb: 雅各的儿子们听见这事，就从田野回来，人人悲愤，极其恼怒；因为示剑在以色列家作了愚妄的事，与雅各的女儿同寝，这本是不该作的事。
verses.text_big5: 雅各的兒子們聽見這事，就從田野回來，人人悲憤，極其惱怒；因為示劍在以色列家作了愚妄的事，與雅各的女兒同寢，這本是不該作的事。
verses.text_en: And the sons of Jacob came in from the field when they heard of it. And the men were grieved and became very angry, because he had committed folly in Israel by lying with Jacob's daughter, for such a thing ought not to be done.
verses.text_gb_plain: 雅各的儿子们听见这事，就从田野回来，人人悲愤，极其恼怒；因为示剑在以色列家作了愚妄的事，与雅各的女儿同寝，这本是不该作的事。
verses.text_big5_plain: 雅各的兒子們聽見這事，就從田野回來，人人悲憤，極其惱怒；因為示劍在以色列家作了愚妄的事，與雅各的女兒同寢，這本是不該作的事。

verses.text_gb: 哈抹和他们商议说，我儿子示剑的心恋慕你们的女儿，求你们将她给我的儿子为妻。
verses.text_big5: 哈抹和他們商議說，我兒子示劍的心戀慕你們的女兒，求你們將她給我的兒子為妻。
verses.text_en: And Hamor spoke with them, saying, The soul of my son Shechem longs for your daughter; please give her to him as a wife.
verses.text_gb_plain: 哈抹和他们商议说，我儿子示剑的心恋慕你们的女儿，求你们将她给我的儿子为妻。
verses.text_big5_plain: 哈抹和他們商議說，我兒子示劍的心戀慕你們的女兒，求你們將她給我的兒子為妻。

verses.text_gb: 你们与我们彼此结亲，你们可以把女儿嫁给我们，也可以娶我们的女儿。
verses.text_big5: 你們與我們彼此結親，你們可以把女兒嫁給我們，也可以娶我們的女兒。
verses.text_en: And make marriages with us: Give your daughters to us, and take our daughters for yourselves.
verses.text_gb_plain: 你们与我们彼此结亲，你们可以把女儿嫁给我们，也可以娶我们的女儿。
verses.text_big5_plain: 你們與我們彼此結親，你們可以把女兒嫁給我們，也可以娶我們的女兒。

verses.text_gb: 你们与我们同住吧。这地都在你们面前，只管住下来，在这里[Fn1]作买卖，置产业。
verses.text_big5: 你們與我們同住罷。這地都在你們面前，只管住下來，在這裏[Fn1]作買賣，置產業。
verses.text_en: And you shall dwell with us, and the land will be before you; dwell and trade in it, and acquire holdings in it.
verses.text_gb_plain: 你们与我们同住吧。这地都在你们面前，只管住下来，在这里作买卖，置产业。
verses.text_big5_plain: 你們與我們同住罷。這地都在你們面前，只管住下來，在這裏作買賣，置產業。

footnotes.zh: 或，来往行动。21节者同。
footnotes.zh_big5: 或，來往行動。21節者同。
footnotes.en: 34:10 1 trade Or, move about. So also in v. 21.

verses.text_gb: 示剑对少女的父亲和弟兄们说，但愿我在你们眼前蒙恩，你们向我要什么，我必给你们。
verses.text_big5: 示劍對少女的父親和弟兄們說，但願我在你們眼前蒙恩，你們向我要甚麼，我必給你們。
verses.text_en: And Shechem said to her father and to her brothers, Let me find favor in your sight, and whatever you say to me I will give.
verses.text_gb_plain: 示剑对少女的父亲和弟兄们说，但愿我在你们眼前蒙恩，你们向我要什么，我必给你们。
verses.text_big5_plain: 示劍對少女的父親和弟兄們說，但願我在你們眼前蒙恩，你們向我要甚麼，我必給你們。

verses.text_gb: 任凭向我要多重的聘金和礼物，我必照你们向我所说的给你们；只要把少女给我为妻。
verses.text_big5: 任憑向我要多重的聘金和禮物，我必照你們向我所說的給你們；只要把少女給我為妻。
verses.text_en: Impose upon me a very large bridal price and gift, and I will give whatever you say to me; but give me the girl as a wife.
verses.text_gb_plain: 任凭向我要多重的聘金和礼物，我必照你们向我所说的给你们；只要把少女给我为妻。
verses.text_big5_plain: 任憑向我要多重的聘金和禮物，我必照你們向我所說的給你們；只要把少女給我為妻。

verses.text_gb: 雅各的儿子们因为示剑玷污了他们的姊妹底拿，就用诡诈的话回答示剑和他父亲哈抹，
verses.text_big5: 雅各的兒子們因為示劍玷污了他們的姊妹底拿，就用詭詐的話回答示劍和他父親哈抹，
verses.text_en: Then the sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father deceitfully; and because he had defiled Dinah their sister, they spoke
verses.text_gb_plain: 雅各的儿子们因为示剑玷污了他们的姊妹底拿，就用诡诈的话回答示剑和他父亲哈抹，
verses.text_big5_plain: 雅各的兒子們因為示劍玷污了他們的姊妹底拿，就用詭詐的話回答示劍和他父親哈抹，

verses.text_gb: 对他们说，我们不能作这事，把我们的姊妹给没有受割礼的人为妻，因为那是我们的羞辱。
verses.text_big5: 對他們說，我們不能作這事，把我們的姊妹給沒有受割禮的人為妻，因為那是我們的羞辱。
verses.text_en: And said to them, We are not able to do this thing, to give our sister to one who is uncircumcised, for that would be a reproach to us.
verses.text_gb_plain: 对他们说，我们不能作这事，把我们的姊妹给没有受割礼的人为妻，因为那是我们的羞辱。
verses.text_big5_plain: 對他們說，我們不能作這事，把我們的姊妹給沒有受割禮的人為妻，因為那是我們的羞辱。

verses.text_gb: 唯有一件事你们必须作，我们才可以应允：若你们所有的男丁都受割礼，和我们一样，
verses.text_big5: 惟有一件事你們必須作，我們纔可以應允：若你們所有的男丁都受割禮，和我們一樣，
verses.text_en: Only on this condition will we consent to you: If you become like us, and every male among you is circumcised,
verses.text_gb_plain: 唯有一件事你们必须作，我们才可以应允：若你们所有的男丁都受割礼，和我们一样，
verses.text_big5_plain: 惟有一件事你們必須作，我們纔可以應允：若你們所有的男丁都受割禮，和我們一樣，

verses.text_gb: 我们就把女儿嫁给你们，也娶你们的女儿；我们便与你们同住，成为一样的人民。
verses.text_big5: 我們就把女兒嫁給你們，也娶你們的女兒；我們便與你們同住，成為一樣的人民。
verses.text_en: Then we will give our daughters to you and will take your daughters for ourselves; and we will dwell with you and become one people.
verses.text_gb_plain: 我们就把女儿嫁给你们，也娶你们的女儿；我们便与你们同住，成为一样的人民。
verses.text_big5_plain: 我們就把女兒嫁給你們，也娶你們的女兒；我們便與你們同住，成為一樣的人民。

verses.text_gb: 倘若你们不听我们，不受割礼，我们就带着我们的[Fn1]姊妹走了。
verses.text_big5: 倘若你們不聽我們，不受割禮，我們就帶著我們的[Fn1]姊妹走了。
verses.text_en: But if you will not listen to us and be circumcised, then we will take our daughter and go.
verses.text_gb_plain: 倘若你们不听我们，不受割礼，我们就带着我们的姊妹走了。
verses.text_big5_plain: 倘若你們不聽我們，不受割禮，我們就帶著我們的姊妹走了。

footnotes.zh: 直译，女儿。
footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，女兒。

verses.text_gb: 哈抹和他的儿子示剑认为这话甚好。
verses.text_big5: 哈抹和他的兒子示劍認為這話甚好。
verses.text_en: And their words seemed good to Hamor and Shechem, Hamor's son.
verses.text_gb_plain: 哈抹和他的儿子示剑认为这话甚好。
verses.text_big5_plain: 哈抹和他的兒子示劍認為這話甚好。

verses.text_gb: 那少年人作这事并不迟延，因为他喜爱雅各的女儿；他在他父亲家中也是人最尊重的。
verses.text_big5: 那少年人作這事並不遲延，因為他喜愛雅各的女兒；他在他父親家中也是人最尊重的。
verses.text_en: And the young man did not delay to do the thing, because he delighted in Jacob's daughter. Now he was honored above all the house of his father.
verses.text_gb_plain: 那少年人作这事并不迟延，因为他喜爱雅各的女儿；他在他父亲家中也是人最尊重的。
verses.text_big5_plain: 那少年人作這事並不遲延，因為他喜愛雅各的女兒；他在他父親家中也是人最尊重的。

verses.text_gb: 哈抹和他儿子示剑到本城的门口，对本城的人说，
verses.text_big5: 哈抹和他兒子示劍到本城的門口，對本城的人說，
verses.text_en: And Hamor and Shechem his son came to the gate of their city and spoke with the men of their city, saying,
verses.text_gb_plain: 哈抹和他儿子示剑到本城的门口，对本城的人说，
verses.text_big5_plain: 哈抹和他兒子示劍到本城的門口，對本城的人說，

verses.text_gb: 这些人与我们和睦相处，不如让他们在这地居住，作买卖；这地也宽阔，足可容纳他们。我们可以娶他们的女儿为妻，也可以把我们的女儿嫁给他们。
verses.text_big5: 這些人與我們和睦相處，不如讓他們在這地居住，作買賣；這地也寬闊，足可容納他們。我們可以娶他們的女兒為妻，也可以把我們的女兒嫁給他們。
verses.text_en: These men are with us peacefully; therefore let them dwell in the land and trade in it, for here the land is large enough for them. Let us take their daughters for ourselves as wives, and let us give them our daughters.
verses.text_gb_plain: 这些人与我们和睦相处，不如让他们在这地居住，作买卖；这地也宽阔，足可容纳他们。我们可以娶他们的女儿为妻，也可以把我们的女儿嫁给他们。
verses.text_big5_plain: 這些人與我們和睦相處，不如讓他們在這地居住，作買賣；這地也寬闊，足可容納他們。我們可以娶他們的女兒為妻，也可以把我們的女兒嫁給他們。

verses.text_gb: 唯有一件事我们必须作，他们才应允和我们同住，成为一样的人民，就是我们中间所有的男丁都受割礼，和他们一样。
verses.text_big5: 惟有一件事我們必須作，他們纔應允和我們同住，成為一樣的人民，就是我們中間所有的男丁都受割禮，和他們一樣。
verses.text_en: Only on this condition will the men consent to us to dwell with us, to become one people: that every male among us be circumcised as they are circumcised.
verses.text_gb_plain: 唯有一件事我们必须作，他们才应允和我们同住，成为一样的人民，就是我们中间所有的男丁都受割礼，和他们一样。
verses.text_big5_plain: 惟有一件事我們必須作，他們纔應允和我們同住，成為一樣的人民，就是我們中間所有的男丁都受割禮，和他們一樣。

verses.text_gb: 他们的群畜、财物、和一切的牲口岂不都归我们么？只要依从他们，他们就与我们同住。
verses.text_big5: 他們的群畜、財物、和一切的牲口豈不都歸我們麼？只要依從他們，他們就與我們同住。
verses.text_en: Will not their livestock and their property and all their animals be ours? Only let us consent to them, and they will dwell with us.
verses.text_gb_plain: 他们的群畜、财物、和一切的牲口岂不都归我们么？只要依从他们，他们就与我们同住。

footnotes.zh: 雅各曾在伯特利向神许愿，承诺神若保守并看顾他，他所立为柱子的石头就必作神的家(二八20～22)。在此，神提醒雅各履行他那一方所许的愿(参三一13)。雅各从巴旦亚兰回来，到了迦南地的示剑，就住在那里(三三18～20)。然而，这构不上神的目标。照着神心头的愿望，神的定旨是要得着伯特利，就是祂在地上的家。因此，雅各必须从示剑往前到伯特利去。三四章一切不幸的事件，都被神主宰的使用，使雅各无法留在示剑，并预备雅各接受神的嘱咐，上伯特利去。雅各经过示剑上到伯特利去，表征我们经过了个人的基督徒生活，上到团体的召会生活，为着建造神永远的居所，就是今日的召会和永世的新耶路撒冷。 伯特利是圣经中的一粒大种子，就是神家的种子。当以色列，变化过的雅各，繁增为以色列家时，在神眼中，以色列家就是神的家(见来三6注1)。至终，帐幕和后来的圣殿被建造起来，象征以色列家乃是旧约时代神在地上的居所。在新约一开头，主耶稣成为肉体而来，作帐幕和圣殿的实际(约一14，二18～21)。然后，在太十六18主预言，祂要以祂的信徒为石头(彼前二5)，以召会为神的居所，神的殿(弗二22，林前三16～17)，建造在祂自己这磐石上(林前三11)。这就是伯特利，神的家(提前三15)。最终，这伯特利要扩大，终极完成于新耶路撒冷，就是神永远的帐幕，在其中有神自己和羔羊为殿(启二一3，22)。见二八12注1。
footnotes.zh_big5: 雅各曾在伯特利向神許願，承諾神若保守並看顧他，他所立為柱子的石頭就必作神的家。（二八20～22。）在此，神題醒雅各履行他那一方所許的願。（參三一13。）雅各從巴旦亞蘭回來，到了迦南地的示劍，就住在那裏。（三三18～20。）然而，這搆不上神的目標。照著神心頭的願望，神的定旨是要得著伯特利，就是祂在地上的家。因此，雅各必須從示劍往前到伯特利去。三四章一切不幸的事件，都被神主宰的使用，使雅各無法留在示劍，並豫備雅各接受神的囑咐，上伯特利去。雅各經過示劍上到伯特利去，表徵我們經過了個人的基督徒生活，上到團體的召會生活，為著建造神永遠的居所，就是今日的召會和永世的新耶路撒冷。ˍ伯特利是聖經中的一粒大種子，就是神家的種子。當以色列，變化過的雅各，繁增為以色列家時，在神眼中，以色列家就是神的家。（見來三6註1。）至終，帳幕和後來的聖殿被建造起來，象徵以色列家乃是舊約時代神在地上的居所。在新約一開頭，主耶穌成為肉體而來，作帳幕和聖殿的實際。（約一14，二18～21。）然後，在太十六18主豫言，祂要以祂的信徒為石頭，（彼前二5，）以召會為神的居所，神的殿，（弗二22，林前三16～17，）建造在祂自己這磐石上。（林前三11。）這就是伯特利，神的家。（提前三15。）最終，這伯特利要擴大，終極完成於新耶路撒冷，就是神永遠的帳幕，在其中有神自己和羔羊為殿。（啟二一3，22。）見二八12註1。
footnotes.en: 35:1 1 Bethel At Bethel Jacob had made a vow to God, promising that if God would preserve him and care for him, the stone which he set up for a pillar would be the house of God (Gen. 28:20-22). Here, God reminded Jacob to fulfill his part of that vow (cf. Gen. 31:13). On his return from Paddan-aram, Jacob came to Shechem in the land of Canaan, and he settled there (Gen. 33:18-20). However, this was short of God's goal. God's purpose according to His heart's desire is to have Bethel, His house on earth. Thus, it was necessary for Jacob to go on from Shechem to Bethel. All the unfortunate events in Gen. 34 were sovereignly used by God to make it impossible for Jacob to remain in Shechem and to prepare Jacob to receive God's charge to go up to Bethel. Jacob's passing through Shechem and going up to Bethel signifies our passing through the individual Christian life and going up to the corporate church life for the building up of God's eternal dwelling place, which is the church today and the New Jerusalem in eternity. Bethel is a great seed in the Bible, a seed of the house of God. When Israel, the transformed Jacob, was multiplied into the house of Israel, in God's eyes the house of Israel was the house of God (see note Heb. 3:6 1 ). Eventually, the tabernacle and later the temple were built as symbols of the house of Israel as God's dwelling place on the earth in the Old Testament time. In the beginning of the New Testament the Lord Jesus came through incarnation to be the reality of the tabernacle and the temple (John 1:14; 2:18-21). Then, in Matt. 16:18 the Lord prophesied that He would build the church as the habitation, the temple, of God (Eph. 2:22; 1 Cor. 3:16-17) on Himself as the rock and with His believers as stones (1 Cor. 3:11; 1 Pet. 2:5). This is Bethel, the house of God (1 Tim. 3:15). Ultimately, this Bethel will be enlarged to consummate in the New Jerusalem, the eternal tabernacle of God, in which God Himself and the Lamb will be the temple (Rev. 21:3, 22). See note Gen. 28:12 1 .

footnotes.zh: 偶像是一切顶替真神的事物(参约壹五20～21)。为着伯特利，神的家，偶像必须除掉(林后六16)。不仅如此，凡是不洁、污秽、玷污之物，都必须清除(林后七1)。要使伯特利成为实际，旧人同其旧生活样式(由旧衣服所表征—赛六四6)，也必须脱去；新人同其新生活样式，就是召会生活，则必须穿上(弗四22～24)。
footnotes.en: 35:2 1 Put; change An idol is anything that replaces the genuine and true God (cf. 1 John 5:20-21). For Bethel, God's house, the idols must be removed (2 Cor. 6:16). Furthermore, everything impure, filthy, or defiled must be cleansed away (2 Cor. 7:1). For the realizing of Bethel, the old man with his old manner of life, signified by the old garments (Isa. 64:6), must also be put off, and the new man with his new manner of life, the church life, must be put on (Eph. 4:22-24).

verses.text_en: And let us rise up and go up to Bethel, that I may make an altar there to the God who answered me in the day of my distress and has been with me wherever I have gone.
verses.text_gb_plain: 我们要起来，上伯特利去，在那里我要筑一座坛给神，就是在我遭难的日子应允我的祷告，在我所行的路上与我同在的那位。
verses.text_big5_plain: 我們要起來，上伯特利去，在那裏我要築一座壇給神，就是在我遭難的日子應允我的禱告，在我所行的路上與我同在的那位。

refs.text_gb: 求你救我脱离我哥哥以扫的手；因为我怕他来击杀我，连妻子带儿女一同击杀了。
refs.text_big5: 求你救我脫離我哥哥以掃的手；因為我怕他來擊殺我，連妻子帶兒女一同擊殺了。
refs.text_en: Deliver me, please, from the hand of my brother, from the hand of Esau, for I fear him, lest he come and attack me and the mother with the children.

refs.text_gb: 于是他们在患难中哀求耶和华，祂就从他们的祸患中搭救他们；
refs.text_big5: 於是他們在患難中哀求耶和華，祂就從他們的禍患中搭救他們；
refs.text_en: Then they cried out to Jehovah in their trouble, / And He delivered them from their distresses.

refs.text_gb: 雅各许愿说，神若与我同在，在我去的路上保守我，又给我食物吃，衣服穿，
refs.text_big5: 雅各許願說，神若與我同在，在我去的路上保守我，又給我食物喫，衣服穿，
refs.text_en: And Jacob vowed a vow, saying, If God will be with me and will keep me in this way that I go and will give me bread to eat and garments to put on,

verses.text_gb: 他们就把手中的一切外邦神像和[Fn1]耳朵上的环子，交给雅各；雅各把这些都藏在示剑附近的橡树底下。
verses.text_big5: 他們就把手中的一切外邦神像和[Fn1]耳朵上的環子，交給雅各；雅各把這些都藏在示劍附近的橡樹底下。
verses.text_en: So they gave Jacob all the foreign gods which were in their hand and the rings which were in their ears, and Jacob hid them under the oak that was near Shechem.
verses.text_gb_plain: 他们就把手中的一切外邦神像和耳朵上的环子，交给雅各；雅各把这些都藏在示剑附近的橡树底下。
verses.text_big5_plain: 他們就把手中的一切外邦神像和耳朵上的環子，交給雅各；雅各把這些都藏在示劍附近的橡樹底下。

footnotes.zh: 耳环是为了美化自己。雅各把耳环连同外邦神像(偶像)都埋了，指明在雅各和他家人的感觉里，耳环与偶像同样可憎(参出三二2～4与2注1)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 耳環是為了美化自己。雅各把耳環連同外邦神像（偶像）都埋了，指明在雅各和他家人的感覺裏，耳環與偶像同樣可憎。（參出三二2～4與2註1。）
footnotes.en: 35:4 1 rings Earrings are for self-beautification. Jacob buried these with the foreign gods, the idols, indicating that in the consciousness of Jacob and his household, the earrings were as abominable as the idols (cf. Exo. 32:2-4 and note Exo. 32:2 1 ).

verses.text_gb: 当他们起行往前时，神使周围城邑的人都[Cra]惊惧，就不追赶雅各的众子。
verses.text_big5: 當他們起行往前時，神使周圍城邑的人都[Cra]驚懼，就不追趕雅各的眾子。
verses.text_en: And as they journeyed, the terror of God was upon the cities that were around them, so they did not pursue the sons of Jacob.
verses.text_gb_plain: 当他们起行往前时，神使周围城邑的人都惊惧，就不追赶雅各的众子。
verses.text_big5_plain: 當他們起行往前時，神使周圍城邑的人都驚懼，就不追趕雅各的眾子。

crossrefs.label: a
crossrefs.raw: 参出十五16，申十一25，书二9，代下十四14

refs.text_gb: 惊骇恐惧临到他们；耶和华啊，因你膀臂的大能，他们如石头寂然不动，直等你的百姓过去，直等你所买的百姓过去。
refs.text_big5: 驚駭恐懼臨到他們；耶和華阿，因你膀臂的大能，他們如石頭寂然不動，直等你的百姓過去，直等你所買的百姓過去。
refs.text_en: Terror and dread have fallen upon them; / By the greatness of Your arm they have become as still as stone, / Until Your people passed over, O Jehovah, / Until the people whom You purchased passed over.

refs.text_gb: 必无一人能在你们面前站立得住；耶和华你们的神必照祂所说的，使你们所踏之地的居民，都因你们惊恐惧怕。
refs.text_big5: 必無一人能在你們面前站立得住；耶和華你們的神必照祂所說的，使你們所踏之地的居民，都因你們驚恐懼怕。
refs.text_en: No man will be able to stand against you; Jehovah your God will put the dread and fear of you upon all the land on which you tread, as He has spoken to you.

refs.text_gb: 对他们说，我知道耶和华已经把这地赐给你们，并且因你们的缘故我们都惊慌了，这地的一切居民，在你们面前也都丧胆了；
refs.text_big5: 對他們說，我知道耶和華已經把這地賜給你們，並且因你們的緣故我們都驚慌了，這地的一切居民，在你們面前也都喪膽了；
refs.text_en: And she said to the men, I know that Jehovah has given you the land, and that the dread of you has fallen upon us, and that all the inhabitants of the land melt before you.

refs.text_gb: 又击破基拉耳四围的一切城邑，因为耶和华使其中的人都甚恐惧。犹大人又将所有的城掠夺一空，因其中可掠夺的财物甚多。
refs.text_big5: 又擊破基拉耳四圍的一切城邑，因為耶和華使其中的人都甚恐懼。猶大人又將所有的城掠奪一空，因其中可掠奪的財物甚多。
refs.text_en: And they struck all the cities surrounding Gerar, for the fear of Jehovah was upon them. And they plundered all the cities, for there was much plunder in them.

verses.text_gb: 于是雅各和一切与他同在的人，到了迦南地的路斯，就是[Cra]伯特利。
verses.text_big5: 於是雅各和一切與他同在的人，到了迦南地的路斯，就是[Cra]伯特利。
verses.text_en: And Jacob came to Luz (that is, Bethel), which is in the land of Canaan, he and all the people who were with him.
verses.text_gb_plain: 于是雅各和一切与他同在的人，到了迦南地的路斯，就是伯特利。
verses.text_big5_plain: 於是雅各和一切與他同在的人，到了迦南地的路斯，就是伯特利。

refs.text_gb: 他就给那地方起名叫伯特利；但那城起先名叫路斯。
refs.text_big5: 他就給那地方起名叫伯特利；但那城起先名叫路斯。
refs.text_en: And he called the name of that place Bethel, but the name of the city was Luz previously.

verses.text_gb: 他在那里筑了一座[Fn1][Cra]坛，并且称那地方为[Fn2]伊勒伯特利，因为当他逃避他[Crb]哥哥的时候，神在那里向他启示祂自己。
verses.text_big5: 他在那裏築了一座[Fn1][Cra]壇，並且稱那地方為[Fn2]伊勒伯特利，因為當他逃避他[Crb]哥哥的時候，神在那裏向他啟示祂自己。
verses.text_en: And he built an altar there and called the place El-bethel, because there God had revealed Himself to him when he fled from his brother.
verses.text_gb_plain: 他在那里筑了一座坛，并且称那地方为伊勒伯特利，因为当他逃避他哥哥的时候，神在那里向他启示祂自己。
verses.text_big5_plain: 他在那裏築了一座壇，並且稱那地方為伊勒伯特利，因為當他逃避他哥哥的時候，神在那裏向他啟示祂自己。

footnotes.zh: 坛是为着奉献。雅各在示剑立坛奉献(三三20)，是为着他个人；他在伯特利筑坛奉献是为着神的家，要完成神永远的定旨，满足神心头的愿望。
footnotes.zh_big5: 壇是為著奉獻。雅各在示劍立壇奉獻，（三三20，）是為著他個人；他在伯特利築壇奉獻是為著神的家，要完成神永遠的定旨，滿足神心頭的願望。
footnotes.en: 35:7 1 altar An altar is for consecration. Jacob's consecration in erecting an altar at Shechem (Gen. 33:20) was for himself as an individual; his consecration in building an altar at Bethel was for the house of God, to fulfill God's eternal purpose and satisfy His heart's desire.

footnotes.zh: 意，伯特利的神。在伯特利，神不再仅仅是个人的神，乃是神的家这团体的神。
footnotes.zh_big5: 意，伯特利的神。在伯特利，神不再僅僅是個人的神，乃是神的家這團體的神。
footnotes.en: 35:7 2 El-bethel Meaning God of Bethel. At Bethel God is no longer merely the God of individuals but the God of a corporate body, the house of God.

refs.text_gb: 耶和华向亚伯兰显现，说，我要把这地赐给你的后裔。亚伯兰就在那里为向他显现的耶和华筑了一座坛。
refs.text_big5: 耶和華向亞伯蘭顯現，說，我要把這地賜給你的後裔。亞伯蘭就在那裏為向他顯現的耶和華築了一座壇。
refs.text_en: And Jehovah appeared to Abram and said, To your seed I will give this land. And there he built an altar to Jehovah who had appeared to him.

refs.text_gb: 神对雅各说，起来，上伯特利去，住在那里；要在那里筑一座坛给神，就是你逃避你哥哥以扫的时候向你显现的那位。
refs.text_big5: 神對雅各說，起來，上伯特利去，住在那裏；要在那裏築一座壇給神，就是你逃避你哥哥以掃的時候向你顯現的那位。
refs.text_en: And God said to Jacob, Rise up, go up to Bethel, and dwell there; and make an altar there to the God who appeared to you when you fled from your brother Esau.

verses.text_gb: 利百加的乳母[Cra]底波拉死了，就葬在伯特利下边的橡树底下；那棵树名叫[Fn1]亚伦巴古。
verses.text_big5: 利百加的乳母[Cra]底波拉死了，就葬在伯特利下邊的橡樹底下；那棵樹名叫[Fn1]亞倫巴古。
verses.text_en: And Deborah, Rebekah's nurse, died, and she was buried below Bethel under the oak; so its name was called Allon-bacuth.
verses.text_gb_plain: 利百加的乳母底波拉死了，就葬在伯特利下边的橡树底下；那棵树名叫亚伦巴古。
verses.text_big5_plain: 利百加的乳母底波拉死了，就葬在伯特利下邊的橡樹底下；那棵樹名叫亞倫巴古。

footnotes.zh: 意，哭泣的橡树。
footnotes.zh_big5: 意，哭泣的橡樹。
footnotes.en: 35:8 1 Allon-bacuth Meaning oak of weeping.

refs.text_gb: 于是他们打发妹妹利百加和她的乳母，同亚伯拉罕的仆人，并跟从仆人的，都走了。
refs.text_big5: 於是他們打發妹妹利百加和她的乳母，同亞伯拉罕的僕人，並跟從僕人的，都走了。
refs.text_en: So they sent away Rebekah their sister and her nurse and Abraham's servant and his men.

verses.text_gb: 雅各从巴旦亚兰回来，神又向他显现，赐福与他，
verses.text_big5: 雅各從巴旦亞蘭回來，神又向他顯現，賜福與他，
verses.text_en: And God appeared to Jacob again when he came from Paddan-aram and blessed him.
verses.text_gb_plain: 雅各从巴旦亚兰回来，神又向他显现，赐福与他，
verses.text_big5_plain: 雅各從巴旦亞蘭回來，神又向他顯現，賜福與他，

verses.text_gb: 并且对他说，你的名原是雅各，从今以后[Cra]不要再叫雅各，要叫[Fn1][Crb]以色列。这样，神就给他起名叫以色列。
verses.text_big5: 並且對他說，你的名原是雅各，從今以後[Cra]不要再叫雅各，要叫[Fn1][Crb]以色列。這樣，神就給他起名叫以色列。
verses.text_en: And God said to him, Your name is Jacob; / Your name shall no longer be called Jacob, / But Israel shall be your name. Thus He called his name Israel.
verses.text_gb_plain: 并且对他说，你的名原是雅各，从今以后不要再叫雅各，要叫以色列。这样，神就给他起名叫以色列。
verses.text_big5_plain: 並且對他說，你的名原是雅各，從今以後不要再叫雅各，要叫以色列。這樣，神就給他起名叫以色列。

footnotes.zh: 神在毗努伊勒把雅各的名改为以色列(三二28)，但在那里雅各对这新名并没有多少经历。乃是在伯特利，雅各才真正更新成为新的人，就是变化过的人(参罗十二2)。这种改变只有在伯特利，也就是在正确的召会生活里，才经历得到。召会完全是一个新人(弗二15)，召会生活乃是变化过之以色列的新生活(加六16)，这生活就是在基督里的神。
footnotes.zh_big5: 神在毘努伊勒把雅各的名改為以色列，（三二28，）但在那裏雅各對這新名並沒有多少經歷。乃是在伯特利，雅各纔真正更新成為新的人，就是變化過的人。（參羅十二2。）這種改變只有在伯特利，也就是在正確的召會生活裏，纔經歷得到。召會完全是一個新人，（弗二15，）召會生活乃是變化過之以色列的新生活，（加六16，）這生活就是在基督裏的神。
footnotes.en: 35:10 1 Israel At Peniel God changed Jacob's name to Israel (Gen. 32:28), but there Jacob did not have much experience of this new name. It was at Bethel that Jacob was actually renewed and became a new person, a transformed person (cf. Rom. 12:2). This kind of change can be experienced only at Bethel, i.e., in the proper church life. The church is altogether a new man (Eph. 2:15), and the church life is the new life of the transformed Israel (Gal. 6:16), which life is God in Christ.

refs.text_gb: 你的名不要再叫亚伯兰，要叫亚伯拉罕，因为我已立你作多国的父。
refs.text_big5: 你的名不要再叫亞伯蘭，要叫亞伯拉罕，因為我已立你作多國的父。
refs.text_en: Your name shall no longer be called Abram, / But your name shall be Abraham; / For I have made you the father of a multitude of nations.

refs.text_gb: 神又对亚伯拉罕说，至于你的妻子撒莱，不可再叫撒莱，她的名要叫撒拉。
refs.text_big5: 神又對亞伯拉罕說，至於你的妻子撒萊，不可再叫撒萊，她的名要叫撒拉。
refs.text_en: And God said to Abraham, As for Sarai your wife, you shall not call her name Sarai, but her name shall be Sarah.

refs.text_gb: 那人说，你的名不要再叫雅各，要叫以色列；因为你与神与人较力，都得了胜。
refs.text_big5: 那人說，你的名不要再叫雅各，要叫以色列；因為你與神與人較力，都得了勝。
refs.text_en: And He said, Your name will no longer be called Jacob, but Israel; for you have struggled with God and with men, and have prevailed.

verses.text_gb: 神又对他说，我是[Fn1][Cra]全足的神；你要[Crb]繁衍增多，将来有一[Fn2][Crc]国，有[Fn3]多民从你而生，又有君王从你腰中而出。
verses.text_big5: 神又對他說，我是[Fn1][Cra]全足的神；你要[Crb]繁衍增多，將來有一[Fn2][Crc]國，有[Fn3]多民從你而生，又有君王從你腰中而出。
verses.text_en: And God said to him, I am the All-sufficient God: / Be fruitful and multiply; / A nation and a company of nations shall come from you, / And kings shall come forth from your loins.
verses.text_gb_plain: 神又对他说，我是全足的神；你要繁衍增多，将来有一国，有多民从你而生，又有君王从你腰中而出。
verses.text_big5_plain: 神又對他說，我是全足的神；你要繁衍增多，將來有一國，有多民從你而生，又有君王從你腰中而出。

footnotes.zh: 希伯来文， El Shaddai， 伊勒沙代。本章和十七章在‘全足的神’(11，十七1)这神圣称呼的启示上，在更改人名表征人的变化(10，十七5)这事上，并在得着繁增而产生多民和君王的应许上，都彼此呼应(11，十七4，6)。这三件事指明神的全足以及祂变化祂的百姓，是要他们繁衍增多，产生变化过的人，作为建造伯特利神家的材料。见十七5注2与15注2。
footnotes.zh_big5: 希伯來文，El Shaddai，伊勒沙代。本章和十七章在“全足的神”（11，十七1）這神聖稱呼的啟示上，在更改人名表徵人的變化（10，十七5）這事上，並在得著繁增而產生多民和君王的應許上，都彼此呼應。（11，十七4，6。）這三件事指明神的全足以及祂變化祂的百姓，是要他們繁衍增多，產生變化過的人，作為建造伯特利神家的材料。見十七5註2與15註2。
footnotes.en: 35:11 1 All-sufficient Heb. El Shaddai. This chapter and Gen. 17 correspond to each other in the revelation of the divine title the All-sufficient God (v. 11; 17:1), in the changing of human names, signifying the transforming of human beings (v. 10; 17:5), and in the promise of multiplication for the bringing forth of nations and kings (v. 11; 17:4, 6). These three matters indicate that God's all-sufficiency and His transforming of His people are for them to be fruitful and multiply to produce transformed persons as materials for the building of God's house, Bethel. See note Gen. 17:5 2 and note Gen. 17:15 2 .

footnotes.zh: 见十七4注1。
footnotes.zh_big5: 見十七4註1。
footnotes.en: 35:11 2 nation See note Gen. 17:4 1 .

footnotes.zh: 直译，多民的会众。
footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，多民的會眾。

refs.text_gb: 亚伯兰年九十九岁的时候，耶和华向他显现，对他说，我是全足的神；你要行在我面前，并且要完全；
refs.text_big5: 亞伯蘭年九十九歲的時候，耶和華向他顯現，對他說，我是全足的神；你要行在我面前，並且要完全；
refs.text_en: And when Abram was ninety-nine years old, Jehovah appeared to Abram and said to him, I am the All-sufficient God; / Walk before Me, and be perfect.

refs.text_gb: 神就赐福给这一切，说，要繁衍增多，充满海中的水；禽鸟也要增多在地上。
refs.text_big5: 神就賜福給這一切，說，要繁衍增多，充滿海中的水；禽鳥也要增多在地上。
refs.text_en: And God blessed them, saying, Be fruitful and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let the birds multiply on the earth.

refs.text_gb: 你的名不要再叫亚伯兰，要叫亚伯拉罕，因为我已立你作多国的父。
refs.text_big5: 你的名不要再叫亞伯蘭，要叫亞伯拉罕，因為我已立你作多國的父。
refs.text_en: Your name shall no longer be called Abram, / But your name shall be Abraham; / For I have made you the father of a multitude of nations.

refs.text_gb: 我必使你的后裔极其繁多；我必使多国从你而立，多王从你而出。
refs.text_big5: 我必使你的後裔極其繁多；我必使多國從你而立，多王從你而出。
refs.text_en: And I will make you exceedingly fruitful; and I will make nations of you, and kings will come forth from you.

refs.text_gb: 我必赐福给她，也要使你从她得一个儿子。我必赐福给她，她也要作多国之母，必有多民的君王从她而出。

footnotes.en: 35:14 1 pillar This was a repetition of what Jacob had done in Gen. 28:18. There Bethel, the house of God, was only a dream; it was not yet Jacob's experience. Here Jacob set up a second pillar at Bethel to consecrate himself to God for the fulfillment of the dream and of his vow to God in Gen. 28:10-22. This pillar was the second landmark in Jacob's experience (see note Gen. 31:52 1 ).

footnotes.zh: 见腓二17注1。这是圣经中头一次提到奠祭(民十五1～5，二八7～10，腓二17，提后四6)。这里提到奠祭，联于伯特利的柱子，指明奠祭是为着神的建造。雅各在柱上浇油之前，先在其上浇奠祭，这表征奠祭的浇奠带进那灵的浇灌(徒二33)，为着圣别神的家(出四十9)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 見腓二17註1。這是聖經中頭一次題到奠祭。（民十五1～5，二八7～10，腓二17，提後四6。）這裏題到奠祭，聯於伯特利的柱子，指明奠祭是為著神的建造。雅各在柱上澆油之前，先在其上澆奠祭，這表徵奠祭的澆奠帶進那靈的澆灌，（徒二33，）為著聖別神的家。（出四十9。）
footnotes.en: 35:14 2 drink See note Phil. 2:17 1 . This is the first mentioning of the drink offering in the Bible (Num. 15:1-5; 28:7-10; Phil. 2:17; 2 Tim. 4:6). Its being mentioned here in connection with the pillar at Bethel indicates that the drink offering is for God's building. The fact that Jacob poured a drink offering upon the pillar before pouring oil upon it signifies that the pouring out of the drink offering brings in the outpouring of the Spirit (Acts 2:33) for the sanctifying of God's house (Exo. 40:9).

footnotes.zh: 拉结是雅各照着他心头愿望的天然选择(二九18～20)。拉结的死乃是雅各丧失他天然的选择，这对他是深刻而切身的对付。雅各失去拉结，但在这过程中却得着预表基督的便雅悯。‘拉结’必须死，‘便雅悯’才能出生。同样的，神至终会取去我们天然的选择，使我们生出基督以彰显神。神的目的不是要祂拣选的人遭受损失；神的目的乃是要借着他们生出基督。
footnotes.zh_big5: 拉結是雅各照著他心頭願望的天然選擇。（二九18～20。）拉結的死乃是雅各喪失他天然的選擇，這對他是深刻而切身的對付。雅各失去拉結，但在這過程中卻得著豫表基督的便雅憫。“拉結”必須死，“便雅憫”纔能出生。同樣的，神至終會取去我們天然的選擇，使我們生出基督以彰顯神。神的目的不是要祂揀選的人遭受損失；神的目的乃是要藉著他們生出基督。
footnotes.en: 35:18 1 died Rachel was Jacob's natural choice according to his heart's desire (Gen. 29:18-20). The death of Rachel was the loss of Jacob's natural choice. This was a deep and personal dealing for Jacob. Jacob lost Rachel, but in the process he gained Benjamin, who was a type of Christ. “Rachel” had to die so that “Benjamin” could be born. In the same manner, God will eventually take away our natural choice so that we may bring forth Christ for His expression. God's goal is not to make His chosen ones suffer loss; it is to bring forth Christ through them.

footnotes.zh: 意，我苦难之子。
footnotes.zh_big5: 意，我苦難之子。
footnotes.en: 35:18 2 Ben-oni Meaning son of my affliction.

footnotes.zh: 意，右手之子。便雅悯是基督的预表；基督先是便俄尼，苦难之子，那是从祂出生开始，经过祂在地上的整个人生(赛五三3)；至终，祂成了便雅悯，神的右手之子，那是从祂复活开始，并在祂的升天里(太二六64)。见诗六八27注1。 拉结给雅各生的两个儿子，便雅悯和约瑟，都是基督的预表。虽然约瑟先出生，但在预表上他是接续便雅悯，因为约瑟生平的记载(三七～五十)，是接在便雅悯出生的记载之后。约瑟像便雅悯一样，预表受苦并得高举的基督。约瑟前半生受苦，是苦难之子；后半生被高举，在法老右边登宝座(四一40～44)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 意，右手之子。便雅憫是基督的豫表；基督先是便俄尼，苦難之子，那是從祂出生開始，經過祂在地上的整個人生；（賽五三3；）至終，祂成了便雅憫，神的右手之子，那是從祂復活開始，並在祂的升天裏。（太二六64。）見詩六八27註1。ˍ拉結給雅各生的兩個兒子，便雅憫和約瑟，都是基督的豫表。雖然約瑟先出生，但在豫表上他是接續便雅憫，因為約瑟生平的記載，（三七～五十，）是接在便雅憫出生的記載之後。約瑟像便雅憫一樣，豫表受苦並得高舉的基督。約瑟前半生受苦，是苦難之子；後半生被高舉，在法老右邊登寶座。（四一40～44。）
footnotes.en: 35:18 3 Benjamin Meaning son of the right hand. Benjamin is a type of Christ, who was first Ben-oni, the Son of affliction, from His birth through His human life on earth (Isa. 53:3), but eventually became Benjamin, the Son at the right hand of God, from His resurrection and in His ascension (Matt. 26:64). See note Psa. 68:27 1 . Benjamin and Joseph, the two sons born to Jacob by Rachel, are both types of Christ. Although Joseph was born first, in typology he is the continuation of Benjamin, for the record of Joseph's life (chs. 37—50) follows the record of Benjamin's birth. Joseph, like Benjamin, typifies the suffering and exalted Christ. During the first part of his life Joseph suffered as the son of affliction, and during the second part he was exalted to the throne at the right hand of Pharaoh (Gen. 41:40-44).

footnotes.zh: 利亚所生的流便是长子，本该承受长子名分。然而，他因着情欲的玷污，失去了长子名分，使长子名分归与拉结的儿子约瑟(代上五1，创四九3～4，四八22)。约瑟因着他的纯洁得了长子名分(三九7～12)。参来十二16与注。

footnotes.en: 35:22 1 lay Reuben, born of Leah, was the firstborn and should have inherited the birthright. However, because of his defilement in his lust, he lost the birthright, and it was given to Joseph, Rachel's son (1 Chron. 5:1; Gen. 49:3-4; 48:22). Joseph gained the birthright because of his purity (Gen. 39:7-12). Cf. Heb. 12:16 and note Heb. 12:16 1 .

footnotes.zh: 雅各经历了更深刻、更切身的对付之后，就在希伯仑进入与神完全的交通里(希伯仑，意，交通，来往)。亚伯拉罕曾经来到示剑(十二6)，经过伯特利(十二8)，并住在希伯仑(十三18，十八1)，而以撒几乎一生都在希伯仑度过。雅各跟随亚伯拉罕的脚踪来到示剑(三三18)，经过伯特利(6)，并住在希伯仑。雅各在希伯仑享受完全的安息、喜乐、满足并与主亲密的交通。他乃是在希伯仑才开始在生命里成熟。

footnotes.en: 35:27 1 Hebron After experiencing the deeper and more personal dealings, Jacob entered into full fellowship with God at Hebron (Hebron means fellowship, communion). Abraham had come to Shechem (Gen. 12:6), had passed through Bethel (Gen. 12:8), and had dwelt in Hebron (Gen. 13:18; 18:1), and Isaac spent nearly his whole life in Hebron. Jacob followed Abraham's footsteps to come to Shechem (Gen. 33:18), to pass through Bethel (Gen. 35:6), and to dwell in Hebron. In Hebron Jacob enjoyed full rest, joy, satisfaction, intimacy, and fellowship with the Lord. It was in Hebron that he began to mature in life.

refs.text_gb: 我要将你寄居的地，就是迦南全地，赐给你和你的后裔永远为业，我也必作他们的神。
refs.text_big5: 我要將你寄居的地，就是迦南全地，賜給你和你的後裔永遠為業，我也必作他們的神。
refs.text_en: And I will give to you and to your seed after you the land of your sojournings, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting possession; and I will be their God.

refs.text_gb: 亚伯兰就搬了帐棚，来到希伯仑幔利的橡树那里居住，在那里为耶和华筑了一座坛。
refs.text_big5: 亞伯蘭就搬了帳棚，來到希伯崙幔利的橡樹那裏居住，在那裏為耶和華築了一座壇。
refs.text_en: And Abram moved his tent and came and dwelt by the oaks of Mamre, which are in Hebron, and there he built an altar to Jehovah.

verses.text_gb: 以撒共活了一百八十岁。
verses.text_big5: 以撒共活了一百八十歲。
verses.text_en: And the days of Isaac were a hundred and eighty years.
verses.text_gb_plain: 以撒共活了一百八十岁。
verses.text_big5_plain: 以撒共活了一百八十歲。

verses.text_gb: 以撒年纪老迈，日子满足，气绝而死，归到他本民那里；他两个儿子以扫、雅各把他[Fn1][Cra]埋葬了。
verses.text_big5: 以撒年紀老邁，日子滿足，氣絕而死，歸到他本民那裏；他兩個兒子以掃、雅各把他[Fn1][Cra]埋葬了。
verses.text_en: And Isaac expired and died and was gathered to his people, an old man and full of days; and Esau and Jacob his sons buried him.
verses.text_gb_plain: 以撒年纪老迈，日子满足，气绝而死，归到他本民那里；他两个儿子以扫、雅各把他埋葬了。
verses.text_big5_plain: 以撒年紀老邁，日子滿足，氣絕而死，歸到他本民那裏；他兩個兒子以掃、雅各把他埋葬了。

footnotes.zh: 以撒乃是在信心里死去，这由他埋葬在麦比拉洞的事实所指明(四九30～32，参二三9与注)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 以撒乃是在信心裏死去，這由他埋葬在麥比拉洞的事實所指明。（四九30～32，參二三9與註。）
footnotes.en: 35:29 1 buried Isaac died in faith, as indicated by the fact that he was buried in the cave of Machpelah (Gen. 49:30-32; cf. Gen. 23:9 and notes).

refs.text_gb: 他们在那里葬了亚伯拉罕和他的妻子撒拉，又在那里葬了以撒和他的妻子利百加；我也在那里葬了利亚。
refs.text_big5: 他們在那裏葬了亞伯拉罕和他的妻子撒拉，又在那裏葬了以撒和他的妻子利百加；我也在那裏葬了利亞。
refs.text_en: There they buried Abraham and Sarah his wife, there they buried Isaac and Rebekah his wife, and there I buried Leah -

verses.text_gb: 以扫就是[Cra]以东，他的后代记在下面。
verses.text_big5: 以掃就是[Cra]以東，他的後代記在下面。
verses.text_en: Now these are the generations of Esau (that is, Edom).
verses.text_gb_plain: 以扫就是以东，他的后代记在下面。
verses.text_big5_plain: 以掃就是以東，他的後代記在下面。

refs.text_gb: 以扫对雅各说，我累昏了，求你给我一些红汤喝。因此以扫又叫以东。
refs.text_big5: 以掃對雅各說，我累昏了，求你給我一些紅湯喝。因此以掃又叫以東。
refs.text_en: And Esau said to Jacob, Let me swallow down some of the red stew, that red stew there, for I am faint. Therefore his name was called Edom.

refs.text_gb: 于是以扫住在西珥山；以扫就是以东。
refs.text_big5: 於是以掃住在西珥山；以掃就是以東。
refs.text_en: And Esau dwelt in Mount Seir; Esau is Edom.

refs.text_gb: 以上的各族都是以扫的子孙；以扫就是以东。
refs.text_big5: 以上的各族都是以掃的子孫；以掃就是以東。
refs.text_en: These are the sons of Esau (that is, Edom), and these are their clans.

refs.text_gb: 玛基叠族、以兰族。这些是以东人在所得为业的地上，按着他们住处的各族。以东人的始祖就是以扫。
refs.text_big5: 瑪基疊族、以蘭族。這些是以東人在所得為業的地上，按著他們住處的各族。以東人的始祖就是以掃。
refs.text_en: Clan Magdiel, Clan Iram. These are the clans of Edom according to their habitations in the land of their possession. This is Esau the father of the Edomites.

verses.text_gb: 以扫娶[Cra]迦南的女子为妻，就是赫人以伦的女儿亚大，和希未人祭便的孙女，亚拿的女儿阿何利巴玛，
verses.text_big5: 以掃娶[Cra]迦南的女子為妻，就是赫人以倫的女兒亞大，和希未人祭便的孫女，亞拿的女兒阿何利巴瑪，
verses.text_en: Esau took his wives from the daughters of Canaan: Adah the daughter of Elon the Hittite; and Oholibamah the daughter of Anah and granddaughter of Zibeon the Hivite;
verses.text_gb_plain: 以扫娶迦南的女子为妻，就是赫人以伦的女儿亚大，和希未人祭便的孙女，亚拿的女儿阿何利巴玛，
verses.text_big5_plain: 以掃娶迦南的女子為妻，就是赫人以倫的女兒亞大，和希未人祭便的孫女，亞拿的女兒阿何利巴瑪，

refs.text_gb: 以扫四十岁的时候娶了赫人比利的女儿犹滴，与赫人以伦的女儿巴实抹为妻。
refs.text_big5: 以掃四十歲的時候娶了赫人比利的女兒猶滴，與赫人以倫的女兒巴實抹為妻。
refs.text_en: Now when Esau was forty years old, he took as wife Judith the daughter of Beeri the Hittite and Basemath the daughter of Elon the Hittite.

verses.text_gb: 又娶了以实玛利的女儿，尼拜约的妹妹巴实抹。
verses.text_big5: 又娶了以實瑪利的女兒，尼拜約的妹妹巴實抹。
verses.text_en: And Basemath Ishmael's daughter, the sister of Nebaioth.
verses.text_gb_plain: 又娶了以实玛利的女儿，尼拜约的妹妹巴实抹。
verses.text_big5_plain: 又娶了以實瑪利的女兒，尼拜約的妹妹巴實抹。

verses.text_gb: 亚大给以扫生了以利法；巴实抹生了流珥；
verses.text_big5: 亞大給以掃生了以利法；巴實抹生了流珥；
verses.text_en: And Adah bore Eliphaz to Esau, and Basemath bore Reuel,
verses.text_gb_plain: 亚大给以扫生了以利法；巴实抹生了流珥；
verses.text_big5_plain: 亞大給以掃生了以利法；巴實抹生了流珥；

verses.text_gb: 阿何利巴玛生了耶乌施、雅兰、可拉。这些都是以扫的儿子，是在迦南地生的。
verses.text_big5: 阿何利巴瑪生了耶烏施、雅蘭、可拉。這些都是以掃的兒子，是在迦南地生的。
verses.text_en: And Oholibamah bore Jeush and Jalam and Korah. These are the sons of Esau, who were born to him in the land of Canaan.
verses.text_gb_plain: 阿何利巴玛生了耶乌施、雅兰、可拉。这些都是以扫的儿子，是在迦南地生的。
verses.text_big5_plain: 阿何利巴瑪生了耶烏施、雅蘭、可拉。這些都是以掃的兒子，是在迦南地生的。

verses.text_gb: 以扫带着他的妻子、儿女、与家中一切的[Fn1]人口，并他的牛羊、牲畜、和一切财物，就是他在迦南地所得的，往别地去，离开了他的弟弟雅各。
verses.text_big5: 以掃帶著他的妻子、兒女、與家中一切的[Fn1]人口，並他的牛羊、牲畜、和一切財物，就是他在迦南地所得的，往別地去，離開了他的弟弟雅各。
verses.text_en: And Esau took his wives and his sons and his daughters and all his household and his livestock and all his cattle and all his possessions which he had acquired in the land of Canaan, and he went into a land away from his brother Jacob.
verses.text_gb_plain: 以扫带着他的妻子、儿女、与家中一切的人口，并他的牛羊、牲畜、和一切财物，就是他在迦南地所得的，往别地去，离开了他的弟弟雅各。
verses.text_big5_plain: 以掃帶著他的妻子、兒女、與家中一切的人口，並他的牛羊、牲畜、和一切財物，就是他在迦南地所得的，往別地去，離開了他的弟弟雅各。

footnotes.zh: 人口，直译，魂。
footnotes.zh_big5: 人口，直譯，魂。

verses.text_gb: 因为二人的[Cra]家产甚多，使他们不能同住一起，他们的群畜太多，寄居的地容不下他们。
verses.text_big5: 因為二人的[Cra]家產甚多，使他們不能同住一起，他們的群畜太多，寄居的地容不下他們。
verses.text_en: For their property was too great for them to dwell together, and the land where they sojourned could not sustain them because of their livestock.
verses.text_gb_plain: 因为二人的家产甚多，使他们不能同住一起，他们的群畜太多，寄居的地容不下他们。
verses.text_big5_plain: 因為二人的家產甚多，使他們不能同住一起，他們的群畜太多，寄居的地容不下他們。

refs.text_gb: 那地容纳不下他们；因为他们的家产甚多，使他们不能同住一起。
refs.text_big5: 那地容納不下他們；因為他們的家產甚多，使他們不能同住一起。
refs.text_en: And the land could not support them that they might dwell together, for their possessions were so great that they could not dwell together.

verses.text_gb: 于是以扫住在西珥山；以扫就是以东。
verses.text_big5: 於是以掃住在西珥山；以掃就是以東。
verses.text_en: And Esau dwelt in Mount Seir; Esau is Edom.
verses.text_gb_plain: 于是以扫住在西珥山；以扫就是以东。
verses.text_big5_plain: 於是以掃住在西珥山；以掃就是以東。

verses.text_gb: 以扫是西珥山以东人的始祖，他的后代记在下面。
verses.text_big5: 以掃是西珥山以東人的始祖，他的後代記在下面。
verses.text_en: And these are the generations of Esau the father of the Edomites in Mount Seir:
verses.text_gb_plain: 以扫是西珥山以东人的始祖，他的后代记在下面。
verses.text_big5_plain: 以掃是西珥山以東人的始祖，他的後代記在下面。

verses.text_gb: 以扫众子的名字如下：以扫的妻子亚大生以利法；以扫的妻子巴实抹生流珥。
verses.text_big5: 以掃眾子的名字如下：以掃的妻子亞大生以利法；以掃的妻子巴實抹生流珥。
verses.text_en: These are the names of Esau's sons: Eliphaz the son of Esau's wife Adah, Reuel the son of Esau's wife Basemath.
verses.text_gb_plain: 以扫众子的名字如下：以扫的妻子亚大生以利法；以扫的妻子巴实抹生流珥。
verses.text_big5_plain: 以掃眾子的名字如下：以掃的妻子亞大生以利法；以掃的妻子巴實抹生流珥。

verses.text_gb: 以利法的儿子是提幔、阿抹、洗玻、迦坦、基纳斯。
verses.text_big5: 以利法的兒子是提幔、阿抹、洗玻、迦坦、基納斯。
verses.text_en: And the sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, and Gatam and Kenaz.
verses.text_gb_plain: 以利法的儿子是提幔、阿抹、洗玻、迦坦、基纳斯。
verses.text_big5_plain: 以利法的兒子是提幔、阿抹、洗玻、迦坦、基納斯。

verses.text_gb: 亭纳是以扫儿子以利法的妾；她给以利法生了[Cra]亚玛力。这些是以扫妻子亚大的子孙。
verses.text_big5: 亭納是以掃兒子以利法的妾；她給以利法生了[Cra]亞瑪力。這些是以掃妻子亞大的子孫。
verses.text_en: And Timna was a concubine to Eliphaz, Esau's son, and she bore Amalek to Eliphaz. These are the sons of Esau's wife Adah.
verses.text_gb_plain: 亭纳是以扫儿子以利法的妾；她给以利法生了亚玛力。这些是以扫妻子亚大的子孙。
verses.text_big5_plain: 亭納是以掃兒子以利法的妾；她給以利法生了亞瑪力。這些是以掃妻子亞大的子孫。

refs.text_gb: 那时，亚玛力人来在利非订，和以色列人争战。
refs.text_big5: 那時，亞瑪力人來在利非訂，和以色列人爭戰。
refs.text_en: Then Amalek came and fought with Israel in Rephidim.

refs.text_gb: 摩西对约书亚说，你为我们选出人来，出去和亚玛力人争战。明天我手里要拿着神的杖，站在山顶上。
refs.text_big5: 摩西對約書亞說，你為我們選出人來，出去和亞瑪力人爭戰。明天我手裏要拿著神的杖，站在山頂上。
refs.text_en: And Moses said to Joshua, Choose men for us, and go out; fight with Amalek. Tomorrow I will stand on the top of the hill with the staff of God in my hand.

refs.text_gb: 于是约书亚照着摩西对他所说的话行，和亚玛力人争战。摩西、亚伦与户珥，都上了山顶。
refs.text_big5: 於是約書亞照著摩西對他所說的話行，和亞瑪力人爭戰。摩西、亞倫與戶珥，都上了山頂。
refs.text_en: So Joshua did as Moses had said to him and fought with Amalek; and Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.

refs.text_gb: 摩西何时举手，以色列人就得胜；何时垂手，亚玛力人就得胜。
refs.text_big5: 摩西何時舉手，以色列人就得勝；何時垂手，亞瑪力人就得勝。
refs.text_en: And when Moses lifted his hand up, Israel prevailed; and when he let his hand down, Amalek prevailed.

refs.text_gb: 但摩西的手发沉，他们就搬一块石头来，放在他以下，他就坐在上面。亚伦与户珥扶着他的手，一个在这边，一个在那边，他的手就稳住，直到日落的时候。
refs.text_big5: 但摩西的手發沉，他們就搬一塊石頭來，放在他以下，他就坐在上面。亞倫與戶珥扶著他的手，一個在這邊，一個在那邊，他的手就穩住，直到日落的時候。
refs.text_en: But Moses' hands were heavy, so they took a stone and put it under him, and he sat on it; and Aaron and Hur supported his hands, one on one side and one on the other side. So his hands were steady until the going down of the sun.

refs.text_gb: 约书亚用刀击败了亚玛力王和他的百姓。
refs.text_big5: 約書亞用刀擊敗了亞瑪力王和他的百姓。
refs.text_en: And Joshua defeated Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword.

refs.text_gb: 耶和华对摩西说，我要将亚玛力的名号从天下全然涂抹；你要将这话写在书上作记念，又念给约书亚听。
refs.text_big5: 耶和華對摩西說，我要將亞瑪力的名號從天下全然塗抹；你要將這話寫在書上作記念，又念給約書亞聽。
refs.text_en: And Jehovah said to Moses, Write this as a memorial in a book and recite it to Joshua, that I will utterly blot out the memory of Amalek from under heaven.

refs.text_gb: 摩西筑了一座坛，起名叫耶和华尼西；
refs.text_big5: 摩西築了一座壇，起名叫耶和華尼西；
refs.text_en: And Moses built an altar and called the name of it Jehovah-nissi;

refs.text_gb: 又说，因为有手敌挡耶和华的宝座；耶和华必世世代代和亚玛力人争战。
refs.text_big5: 又說，因為有手敵擋耶和華的寶座；耶和華必世世代代和亞瑪力人爭戰。
refs.text_en: For he said, For there is a hand against the throne of Jah! Jehovah will have war with Amalek from generation to generation.

refs.text_gb: 巴兰观看亚玛力，就提起诗歌说，亚玛力原为诸国之首，但他终必灭亡。
refs.text_big5: 巴蘭觀看亞瑪力，就題起詩歌說，亞瑪力原為諸國之首，但他終必滅亡。
refs.text_en: And he looked on Amalek and took up his parable and said, Amalek was the first of the nations, / But his latter end shall come to destruction.

refs.text_gb: 你要记得你们出埃及的时候，亚玛力人在路上怎样待你。
refs.text_big5: 你要記得你們出埃及的時候，亞瑪力人在路上怎樣待你。
refs.text_en: Remember what Amalek did to you on the way when you came out of Egypt,

refs.text_gb: 他们在路上遇见你，趁你疲乏困倦的时候，击杀你尽后边软弱的人，并不敬畏神。
refs.text_big5: 他們在路上遇見你，趁你疲乏困倦的時候，擊殺你儘後邊軟弱的人，並不敬畏神。
refs.text_en: That he met you on the way and struck you at the rear, struck all those who were worn out at your rear, when you were faint and weary; and he did not fear God.

refs.text_gb: 所以耶和华你神使你不被四围的一切仇敌扰乱，在耶和华你神赐你承受为业的地上得安息；那时，你要将亚玛力的名号从天下涂抹了，不可忘记。
refs.text_big5: 所以耶和華你神使你不被四圍的一切仇敵擾亂，在耶和華你神賜你承受為業的地上得安息；那時，你要將亞瑪力的名號從天下塗抹了，不可忘記。
refs.text_en: Therefore when Jehovah your God gives you rest from all your enemies surrounding you, in the land which Jehovah your God is giving you as an inheritance to possess, you shall blot out the memory of Amalek from under heaven; you shall not forget.

refs.text_gb: 万军之耶和华如此说，以色列人从埃及上来的时候，在路上亚玛力人抵挡他们；为着亚玛力人向以色列人所作的，我要惩罚他们。
refs.text_big5: 萬軍之耶和華如此說，以色列人從埃及上來的時候，在路上亞瑪力人抵擋他們；為著亞瑪力人向以色列人所作的，我要懲罰他們。
refs.text_en: Thus says Jehovah of hosts, I will punish the Amalekites for what they did to Israel when they set themselves against them in the way as they came up out of Egypt.

refs.text_gb: 现在你要去击打亚玛力人，灭绝他们所有的，不可怜惜他们，将男女、孩童、吃奶的，并牛、羊、骆驼和驴，尽都杀死。
refs.text_big5: 現在你要去擊打亞瑪力人，滅絕他們所有的，不可憐惜他們，將男女、孩童、喫奶的，並牛、羊、駱駝和驢，盡都殺死。
refs.text_en: Go now and strike the Amalekites; and utterly destroy all that they have, and do not spare them, but kill both man and woman, infant and suckling, oxen and sheep, camel and donkey.

refs.text_gb: 撒母耳说，把亚玛力王亚甲带到我这里来。亚甲就欢欢喜喜地来到他那里，因他心里说，死亡的苦楚必定转消了。
refs.text_big5: 撒母耳說，把亞瑪力王亞甲帶到我這裏來。亞甲就歡歡喜喜的來到他那裏，因他心裏說，死亡的苦楚必定轉消了。
refs.text_en: Then Samuel said, Bring Agag the king of the Amalekites near to me. And Agag came to him cheerfully, for Agag said, Surely the bitterness of death has turned.

refs.text_gb: 撒母耳说，你怎样用刀使妇人丧子，你母亲在妇人中也必照样丧子。于是，撒母耳在吉甲耶和华面前，将亚甲砍成碎块。
refs.text_big5: 撒母耳說，你怎樣用刀使婦人喪子，你母親在婦人中也必照樣喪子。於是，撒母耳在吉甲耶和華面前，將亞甲砍成碎塊。
refs.text_en: And Samuel said, Just as your sword has made women childless, so shall your mother be childless among women. And Samuel hewed Agag to pieces before Jehovah in Gilgal.

verses.text_en: And these are the sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah. This is the Anah who found the hot springs in the wilderness as he fed the donkeys of Zibeon his father.

refs.text_gb: 比拉死了，波斯拉人谢拉的儿子约巴接替他作王。

refs.text_en: And Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his place.

refs.text_en: And Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.

refs.text_en: And Husham died; and Hadad the son of Bedad, who struck Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his place; and the name of his city was Avith.

refs.text_en: And Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place.

refs.text_big5: 桑拉死了，大河邊的利河伯人掃羅接替他作王。
refs.text_en: And Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth by the River reigned in his place.

refs.text_en: And Shaul died, and Baal-hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his place.

refs.text_gb: 巴勒哈南死了，哈达接替他作王，他的京城名叫巴伊，他的妻子名叫米希他别，是米萨合的孙女，玛特列的女儿。
refs.text_big5: 巴勒哈南死了，哈達接替他作王，他的京城名叫巴伊，他的妻子名叫米希他別，是米薩合的孫女，瑪特列的女兒。
refs.text_en: And Baal-hanan died, and Hadad reigned in his place. And the name of his city was Pai; and his wife's name was Mehetabel the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.

footnotes.zh: 此时雅各是个变化过的人，但他尚未成熟。变化乃是在我们天然生命里新陈代谢的改变(罗十二2，林后三18)；成熟乃是被那改变我们的神圣生命所充满。我们可能在天然的生命里改变(变化)了，却没有被神圣的生命所充满(成熟。)变化的最后阶段乃是成熟。雅各的变化开始于神摸他的时候(三二25)，继续到三六章末了，那时变化的过程已相当完全(见三七3注1)。三七1～四三14是雅各成熟过程的记载。 创世记展现一幅完整的图画，说到人如何能被重造并变化，有神的形像彰显祂，并有神的管治权代表祂。本书的结束正如它的开始—有神的形像和管治权。本书末后十四章指明，在雅各成为以色列以后，他具有神的形像，并借着约瑟施行神的管治权。要彰显神并有神的管治权，就需要成熟。惟有成熟的生命才能具备神的形像，并施行祂的管治权。
footnotes.zh_big5: 此時雅各是個變化過的人，但他尚未成熟。變化乃是在我們天然生命裏新陳代謝的改變；（羅十二2，林後三18；）成熟乃是被那改變我們的神聖生命所充滿。我們可能在天然的生命裏改變（變化）了，卻沒有被神聖的生命所充滿（成熟。）變化的最後階段乃是成熟。雅各的變化開始於神摸他的時候，（三二25，）繼續到三六章末了，那時變化的過程已相當完全。（見三七3註1。）三七1～四三14是雅各成熟過程的記載。ˍ創世記展現一幅完整的圖畫，說到人如何能被重造並變化，有神的形像彰顯祂，並有神的管治權代表祂。本書的結束正如它的開始—有神的形像和管治權。本書末後十四章指明，在雅各成為以色列以後，他具有神的形像，並藉著約瑟施行神的管治權。要彰顯神並有神的管治權，就需要成熟。惟有成熟的生命纔能具備神的形像，並施行祂的管治權。
footnotes.en: 37:1 1 Jacob At this point Jacob was a transformed person, but he was not yet mature. To be transformed is to be metabolically changed in our natural life (Rom. 12:2; 2 Cor. 3:18); to be mature is to be filled with the divine life that changes us. We may be changed in our natural life (transformed) yet not be filled with the divine life (mature). The last stage of transformation is maturity. Jacob's transformation began at the time God touched him (Gen. 32:25), and it continued until the end of ch. 36, when the process of transformation was relatively complete (see note Gen. 37:3 1 ). Genesis 37:1—43:14 is a record of the process of Jacob's maturity. Genesis shows a complete picture of how human beings can be remade and transformed to express God in His image and represent God with His dominion. This book ends as it begins — with God's image and dominion. The last fourteen chapters indicate that after Jacob had become Israel, he bore the image of God and, through Joseph, exercised the dominion of God. For God's expression and dominion there is the need of maturity. Only a mature life can bear God's image and exercise His dominion.

footnotes.zh: 在创世记末后十四章，雅各和约瑟的传记调合为一，这指明按照属灵的经历，雅各和约瑟乃是一个人(参十二1注1二段，二五1注1二段)。约瑟预表基督是全然完美、没有瑕疵的一位(路二三4，林后五21，来四15，彼前二22)。因此，约瑟代表成熟的以色列掌权的一面，就是基督构成在雅各成熟的性情里。作为由基督这完全者所构成的成熟圣徒，雅各借着约瑟掌权(四一39～44)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 在創世記末後十四章，雅各和約瑟的傳記調合為一，這指明按照屬靈的經歷，雅各和約瑟乃是一個人。（參十二1註1，二五1註1二段。）約瑟豫表基督是全然完美、沒有瑕疵的一位。（路二三4，林後五21，來四15，彼前二22。）因此，約瑟代表成熟的以色列掌權的一面，就是基督構成在雅各成熟的性情裏。作為由基督這完全者所構成的成熟聖徒，雅各藉著約瑟掌權。（四一39～44。）
footnotes.en: 37:2 1 Joseph In the last fourteen chapters of Genesis the biographies of Jacob and Joseph are blended, indicating that according to spiritual experience, Jacob and Joseph are one person (cf. note Gen. 12:1 1 , par. 2 and note Gen. 25:1 1 , par. 2). Joseph is a type of Christ as the One who is altogether perfect, having no defects (Luke 23:4; 2 Cor. 5:21; Heb. 4:15; 1 Pet. 2:22). As such, Joseph represents the reigning aspect of the mature Israel, the constitution of Christ in Jacob's mature nature. As a mature saint constituted of Christ, the perfect One, Jacob reigned through Joseph (Gen. 41:39-44).

footnotes.zh: 约瑟像亚伯一样是牧人。这表征基督在成熟生命里的构成，有一面乃是那照顾人的牧养的生命(约十11，二一15～17)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 約瑟像亞伯一樣是牧人。這表徵基督在成熟生命裏的構成，有一面乃是那照顧人的牧養的生命。（約十11，二一15～17。）
footnotes.en: 37:2 2 shepherding Joseph, like Abel, was a shepherd. This signifies the aspect of the constitution of Christ in the mature life that is the shepherding life to care for others (John 10:11; 21:15-17).

footnotes.zh: 雅各偏爱约瑟，指明他尚未完全变化，多少仍活在天然生命里。雅各对约瑟的偏心使他遭受更多的苦难，这苦难深深摸着他个人的情感。这些末了的对付把他带到完全成熟，能彰显神，并有祂的管治权。
footnotes.zh_big5: 雅各偏愛約瑟，指明他尚未完全變化，多少仍活在天然生命裏。雅各對約瑟的偏心使他遭受更多的苦難，這苦難深深摸著他個人的情感。這些末了的對付把他帶到完全成熟，能彰顯神，並有祂的管治權。
footnotes.en: 37:3 1 more Jacob's preferential love for Joseph indicates that he was not fully transformed but was still living somewhat in the natural life. Jacob's partiality toward Joseph caused him further sufferings, which deeply touched his personal feelings. These final dealings brought him to full maturity for the expression and dominion of God.
